AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Send_Keep_Alive
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Historical C2-only access to inherited common Channel operations. The
   --  canonical common facade supports all five typed families through weak
   --  views; this compatibility child takes a typed C2 owner directly. Channel
   --  selectors and reports are shared with the common package, but the C2
   --  Return owner/result and this child's Comms owner/result remain distinct
   --  Ada types. Handles cannot be substituted across these APIs. These are
   --  wrappers of existing upstream Channel services, not additional services.
   --  Serialize typed-owner operations externally and do not race request Close
   --  against Wait. Native pending work independently retains provider lifetime.

   function Send_Keep_Alive (Channel : Control_Channel) return Return_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Comms_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Submit inherited keep-alive while C2 is Attached or Enabled, without
   --  implicitly enabling. Uses the shared native Return completion engine and
   --  Session admission pool. Exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception;
   --  other native failures raise a provider error. Submission is not completion.
   --  @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; serialize its operations externally.
   --  @return C2 Return observer; use the parent package's Wait/Close and inspect payload separately from outcome.
   type Comms_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Submit_Comms_Test
Comms_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Submit inherited communications test while Attached or Enabled. The
   --  provider send runs after an accounted native lifetime claim. Session
   --  admission refusal raises the resource-exhaustion exception; closed/failed
   --  channels and other native failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Open eligible C2 owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param Channel_ID Unsigned communications-test selector, not a channel UCI identity.
   --  @param Command_ID Canonical command identifier through its C2 compatibility subtype.
   --  @param Request_ID Unsigned communications-test correlation identifier.
   --  @return Legacy observer of an admitted future, not evidence of provider acceptance.
   type Comms_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Status
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Owned legacy communications-test terminal report or explicit rejection.
   --  Uses the parent's outcome/error types and the shared Channel report type,
   --  not the canonical common facade's distinct Ada result owner.
   function Status (Result : Comms_Result) return Outcome;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Report
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Read the cached result category without provider access.
   --  @param Result Legacy communications-test result to inspect.
   --  @return Success for a report or Rejected for an explicit upstream ErrorOr error.
   function Report (Result : Comms_Result) return IR.Channel.Comms_Test_Report
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Copy the report under the declared Success precondition. The expression
   --  body adds no independent outcome check when assertions are disabled.
   --  @param Result Successful legacy result.
   --  @return Shared Channel report containing provider-returned command/request IDs.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Comms_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Description
Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Copy stored text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body does
   --  not independently check outcome. The legacy diagnostic helper substitutes
   --  a fixed native-operation-failure message when the diagnostic is empty.
   --  @param Result Rejected legacy communications-test result.
   --  @return Owned diagnostic, using cached retry for text beyond the initial buffer.
   function Wait (Request : Comms_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Comms_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.signature:
--  Await a terminal report/rejection through the shared native Comms engine.
   --  Results are cached for repeat waits. Timeout raises the inherited timeout
   --  exception without cancellation or consumption; other native failures raise
   --  a provider error. Long rejection text is retried and consistency checked.
   --  Unlike the canonical Ada wrapper, this legacy body directly converts the
   --  native rejection number; native enum mapping still rejects unknown codes.
   --  @param Request Open legacy observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned legacy result, independent of later metadata callbacks.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Common.name: Capabilities

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Metadata_Stream
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned inbound C2 command/BIT metadata and optional communications reports.
   --  Command status is independent of request Wait: accepting a command is not
   --  physical completion and the bridge supplies no additional correlation
   --  guarantee. All kinds share a bounded drop-incoming queue ordered by
   --  successful enqueue, not timestamps. Serialize stream operations and Close.

   type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Limited controlled consumer of a native metadata queue. Provider callbacks
   --  retain queue state independently; the stream has only a weak channel link.
   --  Closing cannot unregister callbacks because upstream provides no unregister.
   function Open
     (Channel : Control_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Attempt one-shot registration in order: BIT configuration, command status,
   --  BIT status. No capability-advertisement gate or automatic communications
   --  registration is used here. Native code rejects a closed channel or prior
   --  metadata attempt; unlike sends it does not require Enabled. Partial failure
   --  leaves installed callbacks safely retaining inactive/failed queue state,
   --  marks the attempt consumed and raises a provider error; reopening is not
   --  a registration rollback. No partially open Ada stream escapes.
   --  @param Channel Open typed C2 owner on which registration has not been attempted.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Positive maximum queued events, default sixteen.
   --  @return Owned consumer for the three base callback families.
   function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Enable_Comms_Test_Events
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Test local stream-handle presence, not channel existence or queue health.
   --  @param Stream Metadata consumer to inspect.
   --  @return True for a present public handle, including an inactive/failed queue.

   procedure Enable_Comms_Test_Events (Stream : in out Metadata_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Metadata_Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Separately attempt communications-test callback registration once per C2
   --  channel while Attached or Enabled. An expired channel, repeated attempt,
   --  provider refusal or exception raises a provider error. The attempt flag is
   --  set before registration, so failure is not retryable. No capability gate
   --  is applied and no other callback registration is undone. Native code checks
   --  channel lifecycle, not an additional queue-active condition; this operation
   --  does not revive an inactive consumer. A closed stream cannot be used.
   --  @param Stream Open stream whose channel admits this first registration attempt.
   type Metadata_Kind is
     (Command_Status_Event, BIT_Configuration_Event, BIT_Status_Event, Channel_Comms_Test_Event);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Command_State
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Inbound event alternatives sharing the same queue and owned-copy policy.
   --  @enum Command_Status_Event Reported command state and inability reason.
   --  @enum BIT_Configuration_Event Supported BIT definitions, items and component references.
   --  @enum BIT_Status_Event Active/completed BITs and fault reports.
   --  @enum Channel_Comms_Test_Event Communications-test report from separately enabled registration.
   type Command_State is (Not_Set, Received, Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Receive
Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Pop the oldest successfully enqueued snapshot. Already queued events
   --  drain before stopped/failed state is reported. Empty active queue timeout
   --  raises the inherited timeout exception; stopped/inactive queue raises
   --  the inherited stopped-stream exception; native/callback terminal failure raises a provider error.
   --  Conversion validates enums and releases native event storage on exceptions.
   --  @param Stream Open queue consumer, externally serialized against Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls.
   --  @return Owned event of any enabled kind, independent of request Wait results.
   function Kind (Event : Metadata_Event) return Metadata_Kind;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Command
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Read the snapshot's event selector without provider access.
   --  @param Event Owned event to inspect.
   --  @return Accessor family applicable to this event.
   function Command (Event : Metadata_Event) return Command_Status
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = Command_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: BIT_Type_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy command status under the declared command-event precondition. The
   --  body returns its stored field without an independent wrong-kind check.
   --  @param Event Command-status event, not a request-completion result.
   --  @return Owned reported command state, reason and diagnostic.
   function BIT_Type_Count (Event : Metadata_Event) return Natural
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Configuration_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: BIT_Type_At
Active_BIT_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a supported test under the declared configuration-event precondition.
   --  The body adds no kind check; index beyond length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Event BIT-configuration event to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based supported-test position, not a BIT ID.
   --  @return Owned supported-test definition.
   function Active_BIT_Count (Event : Metadata_Event) return Natural
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Active_BIT_At
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Count active tests under the declared BIT-status precondition; no separate
   --  body kind check is performed.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @return Number of active reports in provider order.
   function Active_BIT_At (Event : Metadata_Event; Index : Positive) return Active_BIT
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Completed_BIT_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy an active test under the declared BIT-status precondition. The body
   --  adds no kind check; index beyond length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based active-test position, retaining provider order.
   --  @return Owned active-test report.
   function Completed_BIT_Count (Event : Metadata_Event) return Natural
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Completed_BIT_At
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Count completed tests under the declared BIT-status precondition; the body
   --  returns stored length without independently checking kind.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @return Number of completed-test reports in provider order.
   function Completed_BIT_At (Event : Metadata_Event; Index : Positive) return Completed_BIT
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Fault_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a completed test under the declared BIT-status precondition. The body
   --  adds no kind check; index beyond length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based completed-test position.
   --  @return Independent completed-test report and nested item values.
   function Fault_Count (Event : Metadata_Event) return Natural
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Fault_At
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Count fault reports under the declared BIT-status precondition; no separate
   --  body kind check is performed.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @return Number of copied faults, retaining provider order and duplicates.
   function Fault_At (Event : Metadata_Event; Index : Positive) return Fault
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Comms_Test
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a fault under the declared BIT-status precondition. The body does
   --  not check kind; an index beyond length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Event BIT-status event to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based fault-report position, not a fault identifier.
   --  @return Owned fault and all nested associated-data/reference collections.
   function Comms_Test (Event : Metadata_Event) return IR.Channel.Comms_Test_Report
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = Channel_Comms_Test_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Metadata_Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a separately registered communications report under its declared
   --  event-kind precondition. No independent body kind check is performed.
   --  @param Event Communications-test metadata event, not a Comms future result.
   --  @return Owned shared Channel report containing command/request identifiers.

   type Metadata_Counters is record
      Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Native unsigned counters saturate at their maximum and do not wrap. A
   --  callback increments received before checking whether the queue is active.
   --  @field Events_Received Callback entries observed, including entries not ultimately enqueued.
   --  @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid converted incoming events dropped because the bounded queue was full.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null/malformed/unsupported converted events dropped non-terminally; callback exceptions instead fail the stream.
   function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata.signature:
--  Read a synchronized counter snapshot; a closed handle or native failure
   --  raises a provider error. Counts need not sum to received when inactive
   --  callbacks or terminal conversion failures occurred.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata queue consumer.
   --  @return Owned saturating counter values observed at query time.
   procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Control_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Safe typed command-and-control channel and asynchronous command owners.
   --  Open attaches; Enable is explicit. Typed sends require Enabled, unlike
   --  inherited common operations which also admit Attached. Serialize owner
   --  operations externally. Native submission accounts lifetime under its lock
   --  and calls provider send unlocked; this is not permission to race public
   --  Ada owners. Future completion is not proof of a physical state transition
   --  or completed BIT; command-status metadata is a separate reporting path.

   type Control_Config is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Create_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Owned channel/platform identities and sensor component location used to
   --  attach a command-and-control channel; constructing it opens no resources.
   function Create_Config
     (Channel_ID : UCI_ID; Platform_ID : UCI_ID; Sensor_Location : Component_Location)
      return Control_Config;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Control_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Copy attachment configuration without provider access or text validation.
   --  @param Channel_ID Requested channel UCI identity and label.
   --  @param Platform_ID Platform UCI identity and label.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Sensor offsets and location identity to copy.
   --  @return Independent configuration value used by Open.

   type Control_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Limited controlled typed owner retaining native Session/provider lifetime.
   --  Explicit Close is preferred; non-raising finalization is a fallback.
   --  Pending native requests independently retain the necessary provider graph.
   function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Control_Config) return Control_Channel;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Require an open Session, published command-and-control capability and a
   --  successful typed attachment. Text is validated as UTF-8 by native code.
   --  The returned channel is Attached, not enabled; failure raises a provider
   --  error and no partially open Ada owner escapes.
   --  @param Parent Open provider Session whose native state is retained.
   --  @param Config Attachment identities and sensor location to copy.
   --  @return Attached typed owner; call Enable before typed command submission.
   function Is_Open (Channel : Control_Channel) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Enable
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Test local handle presence, not Enabled state or provider health.
   --  @param Channel Typed owner to inspect without a provider call.
   --  @return True for a present native handle, even when lifecycle has failed.
   procedure Enable (Channel : in out Control_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: As_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Enable an Attached channel; already Enabled is idempotent. Provider
   --  refusal or exception makes the native lifecycle Failed and raises a
   --  provider error; a failed channel is not re-enabled by retrying this call.
   --  @param Channel Open Attached or already Enabled owner; serialize owner operations.

   --  Returns a new weak common Channel view of this open Control_Channel.
   --  Raises Provider_Error if the Control_Channel is closed; no open View
   --  escapes on failure. The View does not own or keep this owner alive, and
   --  closing the View does not close this owner. See AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.
   function As_Channel (Channel : Control_Channel) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Command_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Allocate a weak common view without changing attachment or enabling.
   --  A closed owner raises a provider error; the view does not retain this
   --  owner and its closure does not close the typed channel.
   --  @param Channel Open typed owner whose resource is weakly referenced.
   --  @return Independent weak view; handle presence is not lifecycle eligibility.

   --  Source-compatible name for the canonical common command identifier.
   subtype Command_ID is AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Command_ID;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: BIT_ID
BIT_ID_Array
MFA_State
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Standard positive-index vector of owned fault-code strings. Fault-clear
   --  submission preserves order and duplicates and copies length-delimited
   --  UTF-8 text; this instance adds no generated first-party declarations.

   type MFA_State is
     (Not_Set,
      Unknown,
      Not_Installed,
      Off,
      Pre_Initialization,
      Initialization,
      Standby,
      Operate,
      Operate_Rx_Only,
      Operate_Tx_Only,
      Maintenance,
      Calibration,
      Initiated_BIT,
      Shutdown,
      Degraded);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Coordinate_Frame_Reference
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature: type Coordinate_Frame_Reference is (Inertial, Aircraft);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Degradation_Method
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
type Degradation_Method is
     (Capacity_Degradation, Volume_Degradation, Range_Degradation, Revisit_Degradation);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Scan_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature: type Scan_Value is mod 2**32 with Size => 32;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Scan_Parameters
Mode_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Record defaults: False elevation selection; zero scalars, angles and
   --  intervals; Inertial elevation reference, Aircraft azimuth reference and
   --  capacity degradation. This value is not a provider validity guarantee.

   type Mode_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: MFA_Mode
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Limited controlled observer of a Mode future. Native pending work retains
   --  the provider graph independently of observer/channel/Session closure.
   --  Finalization is non-raising; explicit Close must not race Wait.
   type MFA_Mode is (Unused, Task_Sched, Scan_Volume_Sched, Scan_Bar_Sched);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_Mode
Submit_Operate
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit a complete ModeCmd while Enabled. Inputs are copied before send;
   --  no state/mode/scan feasibility validation is promised. The native lifetime
   --  claim precedes unlocked provider send. Session admission exhaustion raises
   --  the resource-exhaustion exception; other failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, preserved with all 32 bits.
   --  @param State Requested state, not proof of a completed transition.
   --  @param Mode Requested mode category; provider determines acceptance.
   --  @param Scan_Parameters Complete copied scan payload, defaulting to record defaults.
   --  @return Admitted request observer; terminal result and later metadata are separate.
   function Submit_Operate (Channel : Control_Channel; ID : Command_ID := 0) return Mode_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Convenience ModeCmd submission selecting Operate, task-scheduling mode
   --  and upstream default scan parameters. Requires Enabled and has the same
   --  admission/error/lifetime rules as full mode submission; not a new service.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier; defaults to zero.
   --  @return Mode request observer, not confirmation of physical operation.
   function Is_Open (Request : Mode_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Return_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Inspect Mode observer handle presence without polling provider completion.
   --  @param Request Mode observer to inspect.
   --  @return True for a present public handle, pending or terminal.

   type Return_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_BIT_No_Op
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Limited controlled observer of a Return future, also used by legacy C2
   --  keep-alive. It is not the canonical common package's Ada request type.
   --  Closing/finalizing does not cancel native work or release a pending permit.
   function Submit_BIT_No_Op
     (Channel : Control_Channel; ID : Command_ID := 0) return Return_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit a BIT command with all three payload lists empty while Enabled.
   --  This is not a command to initiate an unspecified test. Admission exhaustion
   --  raises the resource-exhaustion exception; other failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param ID BIT command correlation identifier, default zero.
   --  @return Return request observer, whose successful payload may still be Fail.
   function Is_Open (Request : Return_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_BIT_Initiate
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Test Return observer handle presence, not provider completion or success.
   --  @param Request Return observer to inspect.
   --  @return True for a present native observer handle.
   --  These safe operations enforce the upstream one-choice BIT rule. Each
   --  payload-specific operation requires a nonempty owned Ada collection.
   function Submit_BIT_Initiate
     (Channel : Control_Channel; IDs : BIT_ID_Array; ID : Command_ID := 0) return Return_Request
   with Pre => IDs'Length > 0;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_BIT_Cancel
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit only the initiate-ID list while Enabled, leaving cancel and fault
   --  lists empty. The declared nonempty precondition is not independently
   --  checked by the shared body if assertion checking is disabled. Native send
   --  copies IDs; admission exhaustion and other failures follow mode submission.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; serialize owner operations.
   --  @param IDs Nonempty ordered numeric BIT selectors; duplicate IDs are preserved.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero.
   --  @return Return observer; future completion does not prove BIT execution finished.
   function Submit_BIT_Cancel
     (Channel : Control_Channel; IDs : BIT_ID_Array; ID : Command_ID := 0) return Return_Request
   with Pre => IDs'Length > 0;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_BIT_Clear_Faults
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit only the cancel-ID list while Enabled; initiate and fault lists
   --  remain empty. The declared nonempty precondition has no separate body
   --  check with assertions disabled. IDs are copied before provider send.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; serialize owner operations.
   --  @param IDs Nonempty ordered numeric BIT selectors to cancel, retaining duplicates.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero.
   --  @return Admitted Return observer, not evidence that cancellation physically completed.
   function Submit_BIT_Clear_Faults
     (Channel : Control_Channel; Fault_Codes : Fault_Code_Vectors.Vector; ID : Command_ID := 0)
      return Return_Request
   with Pre => not Fault_Codes.Is_Empty;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: System_Time_Nanoseconds
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit only fault-code text while Enabled, leaving both BIT-ID lists
   --  empty. The declared precondition requires a nonempty vector; the body's
   --  Positive length conversion also fails for empty input. Native code copies
   --  each length-delimited UTF-8 string but rejects embedded NUL bytes.
   --  Invalid UTF-8 or other native failures raise a provider error; Session
   --  admission exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; serialize owner operations.
   --  @param Fault_Codes Nonempty ordered vector of fault-code strings, retaining duplicates.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero.
   --  @return Return observer; payload success and physical fault clearance are distinct.
   type System_Time_Nanoseconds is range -(2**63) .. (2**63) - 1 with Size => 64;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Submit_Config_Set
Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Submit ConfigSetCommand while Enabled. Native code validates UTF-8 and
   --  copies the complete length-delimited text, rejecting embedded NUL bytes;
   --  it does not parse configuration syntax or establish timestamp semantics.
   --  Session admission exhaustion raises the resource-exhaustion exception;
   --  closed/ineligible channels and other native failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Enabled typed owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param ID Command correlation identifier, default zero.
   --  @param System_Time_NS Signed nanosecond count, default zero, with no asserted epoch.
   --  @param Config Opaque UTF-8 configuration text; empty text is permitted.
   --  @return Admitted Return observer, not confirmation that configuration is active.

   type Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Terminal future result category, not submission status or physical success.
   --  @enum Success A typed payload was returned; a Return payload may still be Fail.
   --  @enum Rejected Explicit upstream ErrorOr rejection, not a provider exception.
   type Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Mode_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Known upstream rejection categories mapped to native values 0..8.
   --  Session admission refusal is a separate exception, not one of these results.
   --  @enum None No-error category, value 0, preserved if present in an upstream error.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7.
   --  @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8.
   type Mode_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Status
Mode
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the stored Mode result category without provider access.
   --  @param Result Owned Mode result to inspect.
   --  @return Payload success or explicit rejection.
   function Mode (Result : Mode_Result) return MFA_Mode
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the returned mode under the declared Success precondition. The body
   --  directly returns its field without an independent assertion-disabled check.
   --  @param Result Successful Mode result.
   --  @return Provider-returned mode, not a bridge-verified physical state.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Mode_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the error code under the declared Rejected precondition; the body
   --  performs no independent outcome check.
   --  @param Result Rejected Mode result.
   --  @return Explicit upstream rejection category.
   function Description (Result : Mode_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Command_Return
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition. The body
   --  returns stored text without independently checking the outcome.
   --  @param Result Rejected Mode result.
   --  @return Complete owned diagnostic, with long native diagnostics retried from cache.
   type Command_Return is (Return_Success, Bad_Pointer, Fail, Not_Supported, Not_Implemented);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Return_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Return payload categories under a successful future result, values 0..4.
   --  @enum Return_Success Upstream Return::Success, value 0.
   --  @enum Bad_Pointer Upstream Return::BadPointer, value 1.
   --  @enum Fail Upstream Return::Fail, value 2; not a bridge/provider exception.
   --  @enum Not_Supported Upstream Return::NotSupported, value 3.
   --  @enum Not_Implemented Upstream Return::NotImplemented, value 4, representing an unimplemented command.
   type Return_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Status
Value
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the stored Return result category.
   --  @param Result Owned Return result to inspect.
   --  @return Payload success or explicit upstream rejection.
   function Value (Result : Return_Result) return Command_Return
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the payload under the declared Success precondition. There is no
   --  independent outcome check in the expression-function body.
   --  @param Result Successful Return result.
   --  @return Provider Return value; inspect it separately from result status.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Return_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Read the rejection code under the declared Rejected precondition; the
   --  body does not independently check the outcome.
   --  @param Result Rejected Return result.
   --  @return Explicit upstream error category.
   function Description (Result : Return_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body
   --  simply copies its stored string.
   --  @param Result Rejected Return result.
   --  @return Complete owned rejection diagnostic, not a truncated buffer prefix.

   --  Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR. Timeout never cancels or
   --  consumes either request type; Wait may be repeated and a later Wait may
   --  return its cached terminal result. Close must not race Wait on the same
   --  Mode_Request or on the same Return_Request.
   function Wait (Request : Mode_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Mode_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Await the future or return its cached terminal result. Timeout raises the
   --  inherited timeout exception without consumption or cancellation. Other
   --  native/provider failures raise a provider error; explicit rejection is a
   --  result. No guarantee of physical transition completion follows.
   --  @param Request Open Mode observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned terminal mode or rejection, repeatable from the native cache.
   function Wait (Request : Return_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Return_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Await a Return payload or explicit rejection, cached for repeated waits.
   --  Timeout raises the inherited timeout exception without cancellation;
   --  other native/provider failures raise a provider error. Success may contain
   --  Fail and does not establish physical completion of a command.
   --  @param Request Open Return observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned terminal payload or explicit rejection.

   procedure Close (Request : in out Mode_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.C2.name: Close
Close
AMS.MEL.IR.C2.signature:
--  Idempotently close only the Return observer, not pending provider work.
   --  No immediate permit release or physical cancellation is promised.
   --  @param Request Observer to clear; must not race Wait; native failure raises a provider error.
   procedure Close (Channel : in out Control_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Command_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Shared channel capability snapshots and the weak common-channel facade.
   --  Capability values describe provider reports, not a promise that the Ada
   --  bridge implements every advertised operation. Reading metadata support
   --  does not register a callback. Snapshots own their strings and collections
   --  independently of the provider, Session and typed channel.

   type Command_ID is mod 2**32 with Size => 32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Comms_Channel_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Canonical unsigned 32-bit command correlation identifier. The C2 command
   --  identifier is a compatibility subtype of this same type; all bits survive
   --  common request and report conversion.
   type Comms_Channel_ID is mod 2**32 with Size => 32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Comms_Request_ID
Comms_Test_Report
Channel_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Owned correlation values returned in a communications-test report.
   --  @field Command_ID Command identifier reported by the provider.
   --  @field Request_ID Communications-test request identifier reported by the provider.

   type Channel_Type is
     (IRST_Track,
      IRST_Image,
      Command_And_Control,
      Scheduling,
      Health_And_Status,
      Instrumentation,
      Stacked_Image,
      Reserved_1,
      Reserved_2);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Pixel_Format
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Published channel categories, in the pinned upstream numeric order 0..8.
   --  A category can be represented without its service being implemented here.
   --  @enum IRST_Track Infrared search-and-track channel category, value 0.
   --  @enum IRST_Image Infrared search-and-track image channel category, value 1.
   --  @enum Command_And_Control Command-and-control channel category, value 2.
   --  @enum Scheduling Task-scheduling channel category, value 3; not a generic Ada scheduling service.
   --  @enum Health_And_Status Health-and-status channel category, value 4.
   --  @enum Instrumentation Instrumentation channel category, value 5.
   --  @enum Stacked_Image Stacked-image channel category, value 6; representation does not add an image API.
   --  @enum Reserved_1 Reserved upstream category, value 7; no supported functionality is implied.
   --  @enum Reserved_2 Reserved upstream category, value 8; no supported functionality is implied.
   type Pixel_Format is (Mono, RGB, Bayer);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Sensor_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Provider-reported image format category, not a complete byte layout.
   --  @enum Mono Monochrome category, upstream value 0.
   --  @enum RGB Red/green/blue category, upstream value 1; packing is not specified by this literal.
   --  @enum Bayer Bayer category, upstream value 2; the literal does not identify a mosaic pattern.
   type Sensor_Type is
     (Unspecified, Gimbal_Horizontal, Gimbal_Vertical, Gimbal_Rotation, Step_Stare);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Metadata_Capability
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Published sensor-mechanization reports. Provider-specific values beyond
   --  the upstream exclusive sentinel are not represented by this Ada type.
   --  @enum Unspecified Unknown sensor capabilities, upstream value 0.
   --  @enum Gimbal_Horizontal Sensor can pivot about the horizontal axis, value 1.
   --  @enum Gimbal_Vertical Sensor can pivot about the vertical axis, value 2.
   --  @enum Gimbal_Rotation Sensor can rotate through 360 degrees, value 3.
   --  @enum Step_Stare Step-stare mechanization used for scanning, value 4.
   type Metadata_Capability is
     (Bad_Pixel_List,
      Optical_Distortion_Map,
      LF_Status,
      Line_Of_Sight_Report,
      Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion,
      Line_Of_Sight_Euler,
      MFA_Status,
      MFA_Status_Detailed,
      BIT_Configuration,
      Command_Status,
      BIT_Status,
      Candidate_Object_Message,
      Task_Executing_Rep,
      Subsystem_Status_Resp,
      Execute_Task_Ack,
      Sched_Created_Rep,
      IRST_Track_Report,
      Channel_Comms_Test_Rep,
      Camera_Command_Resp,
      Camera_Protect_Cmd_Resp,
      Instrumentation_Report,
      Navigation_Report_Resp,
      Request_System_Track_Data,
      Update_Track_List_Response,
      LOS_3D_Kinematics_Type,
      Candidate_Object_Preproc_Message,
      Task_Events,
      Scan_Performance_Report,
      Reserved_3,
      Reserved_5,
      Reserved_9,
      Reserved_10);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Band_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Metadata callback categories in pinned upstream numeric order 0..31.
   --  Upstream expects an unadvertised callback registration to return
   --  NotSupported. Advertisement does not itself register the callback or
   --  establish that a corresponding safe Ada registration API exists.
   --  @enum Bad_Pixel_List BadPixelList callback category, value 0.
   --  @enum Optical_Distortion_Map OpticalDistortionMap callback category, value 1.
   --  @enum LF_Status LFStatus callback category, value 2.
   --  @enum Line_Of_Sight_Report LineOfSightReport callback category, value 3.
   --  @enum Line_Of_Sight_Quaternion LineOfSightQuaternion callback category, value 4.
   --  @enum Line_Of_Sight_Euler LineOfSightEuler callback category, value 5.
   --  @enum MFA_Status MFA status callback category, value 6.
   --  @enum MFA_Status_Detailed Detailed MFA status callback category, value 7.
   --  @enum BIT_Configuration Built-in-test configuration callback category, value 8.
   --  @enum Command_Status CommandStatus callback category, value 9.
   --  @enum BIT_Status Built-in-test status callback category, value 10.
   --  @enum Candidate_Object_Message CandidateObjectMessage callback category, value 11.
   --  @enum Task_Executing_Rep TaskExecutingRep callback category, value 12.
   --  @enum Subsystem_Status_Resp SubsystemStatusResp callback category, value 13.
   --  @enum Execute_Task_Ack ExecuteTaskAck callback category, value 14.
   --  @enum Sched_Created_Rep SchedCreatedRep callback category, value 15.
   --  @enum IRST_Track_Report IRSTTrackReport callback category, value 16.
   --  @enum Channel_Comms_Test_Rep ChannelCommsTestRep callback category, value 17.
   --  @enum Camera_Command_Resp CameraCommandResp callback category, value 18.
   --  @enum Camera_Protect_Cmd_Resp CameraProtectCmdResp callback category, value 19.
   --  @enum Instrumentation_Report InstrumentationReport callback category, value 20.
   --  @enum Navigation_Report_Resp NavigationReportResp callback category, value 21.
   --  @enum Request_System_Track_Data RequestSystemTrackData inbound callback category, value 22.
   --  @enum Update_Track_List_Response UpdateTrackListResponse callback category, value 23.
   --  @enum LOS_3D_Kinematics_Type Three-dimensional line-of-sight kinematics callback category, value 24.
   --  @enum Candidate_Object_Preproc_Message CandidateObjectPreProcMessage inbound callback category, value 25.
   --  @enum Task_Events TaskEvents callback category, value 26.
   --  @enum Scan_Performance_Report ScanPerformanceReport callback category, value 27.
   --  @enum Reserved_3 Reserved upstream category, value 28, not implemented functionality.
   --  @enum Reserved_5 Reserved upstream category, value 29, not implemented functionality.
   --  @enum Reserved_9 Reserved upstream category, value 30, not implemented functionality.
   --  @enum Reserved_10 Reserved upstream category, value 31, not implemented functionality.
   type Band_Type is
     (Invalid,
      Multiband,
      IR_Far,
      IR_Near,
      IR_Longwave,
      IR_Midwave,
      IR_Shortwave,
      Visible_White,
      Visible_Red,
      Visible_Green,
      Visible_Blue,
      UVA,
      UVB,
      UVC,
      UV_Vacuum);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Coordinate_System_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Spectral categories; numeric wavelength limits are supplied separately.
   --  @enum Invalid Invalid/default band category, upstream value 0.
   --  @enum Multiband Simultaneous frequency spectra, value 1.
   --  @enum IR_Far Far infrared category, value 2.
   --  @enum IR_Near Near infrared category, value 3.
   --  @enum IR_Longwave Longwave infrared category, value 4.
   --  @enum IR_Midwave Midwave infrared category, value 5.
   --  @enum IR_Shortwave Shortwave infrared category, value 6.
   --  @enum Visible_White White light in the visible spectrum, value 7.
   --  @enum Visible_Red Red light in the visible spectrum, value 8.
   --  @enum Visible_Green Green light in the visible spectrum, value 9.
   --  @enum Visible_Blue Blue light in the visible spectrum, value 10.
   --  @enum UVA Ultraviolet A category, value 11.
   --  @enum UVB Ultraviolet B category, value 12.
   --  @enum UVC Ultraviolet C category, value 13.
   --  @enum UV_Vacuum Vacuum ultraviolet category, value 14.
   type Coordinate_System_Type is (LLA, ECEF, NED_Platform, NED_Sensor);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Band_Info
Image_Band
Channel_Capability
Create_Capability
Channel_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Construct a local owned value by copying every argument. This does not
   --  query a provider, validate spectral bounds or enforce native set/map
   --  uniqueness, ordering or the upstream 8-bit band-key range.
   --  @param Channel_ID Channel UCI identity, including its descriptive label.
   --  @param Height Reported image-buffer height.
   --  @param Width Reported image-buffer width.
   --  @param Bit_Depth Image dynamic-range bit depth, not necessarily storage width.
   --  @param Row_Pitch Image-buffer row pitch in bytes.
   --  @param Buffer_Size Buffer-size scalar; copied independently of image size and row pitch.
   --  @param Image_Size Image-size scalar; no product of dimensions is calculated.
   --  @param Number_Of_Bands Reported number of EOIR bands, independent of map-entry count.
   --  @param Format Reported pixel category, not a complete layout description.
   --  @param Sensor_Types Ordered sensor-mechanization reports, including duplicates.
   --  @param Platform_ID Platform UCI identity, including its descriptive label.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Sensor component-location value to copy.
   --  @param Channel_Types Ordered channel categories, including duplicates.
   --  @param Task_Schedule_Depth Reported queued-task capacity, not bridge scheduling state.
   --  @param ODC_Available Whether the provider reports an optical-distortion map is available.
   --  @param NUC_Available Whether the provider reports that it performs nonuniformity correction.
   --  @param Metadata Metadata advertisements; constructing this value registers no callbacks.
   --  @param Image_Bands Band-map entries in supplied order, without sorting or key validation.
   --  @param Nav_Frames Ordered navigation-frame reports; an empty vector is permitted.
   --  @return Independent capability value retaining all supplied fields.

   function Channel_ID (Value : Channel_Capability) return UCI_ID;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Height
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy the reported channel identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Channel UCI identifier, not a communications-test channel selector.
   function Height (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Width
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the reported image-buffer height without deriving allocation size.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Height scalar supplied by the provider or local constructor.
   function Width (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Bit_Depth
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the reported image-buffer width without deriving allocation size.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Width scalar supplied by the provider or local constructor.
   function Bit_Depth (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Row_Pitch
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read image dynamic-range bit depth, for example an ADC's 12-bit range.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Reported bit depth; not necessarily the storage bits per pixel.
   function Row_Pitch (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Buffer_Size
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read image-buffer row pitch independently of width and image size.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Reported row pitch in bytes.
   function Buffer_Size (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Image_Size
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the distinct upstream buffer-size scalar. The pinned getter supplies
   --  no stronger unit or relationship to image size; no size is recomputed.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Stored buffer-size value.
   function Image_Size (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Number_Of_Bands
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the distinct upstream image-size scalar. The pinned getter supplies
   --  no stronger unit or relationship to buffer size; no size is recomputed.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Stored image-size value.
   function Number_Of_Bands (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Format
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the reported number of different EOIR bands produced by the MFA.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Reported band count, not the number of entries in the band map.
   function Format (Value : Channel_Capability) return Pixel_Format;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Sensor_Type_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the pixel category without specifying packing or a Bayer pattern.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Reported monochrome, RGB or Bayer category.
   function Sensor_Type_Count (Value : Channel_Capability) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Sensor_Type_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count stored sensor reports, retaining duplicates from provider vectors.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of entries available through positive positional indices.
   function Sensor_Type_At (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Sensor_Type;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Platform_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read a sensor report in stored order; an index beyond length raises
   --  a constraint error through the underlying Ada vector.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based vector position, not a sensor identifier.
   --  @return Sensor-mechanization report at the selected position.
   function Platform_ID (Value : Channel_Capability) return UCI_ID;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Sensor_Location
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy the reported platform identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Stored platform UCI identifier.
   function Sensor_Location (Value : Channel_Capability) return Component_Location;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Channel_Type_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy the sensor component location, retaining offsets and location ID.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Independent component-location value; no coordinate conversion occurs.
   function Channel_Type_Count (Value : Channel_Capability) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Channel_Type_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count reported channel categories in the copied provider vector.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of entries, including any duplicates.
   function Channel_Type_At (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Channel_Type;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Task_Schedule_Depth
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read a category without asserting that the bridge implements it.
   --  An index beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based position in stored provider order.
   --  @return Reported channel category at that position.
   function Task_Schedule_Depth (Value : Channel_Capability) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: ODC_Available
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read reported task-queue capacity. Upstream describes a positive value as
   --  tasks queued after the current task; zero lets an IMMEDIATE task replace
   --  the current task. This report adds no bridge scheduling implementation.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Reported task-schedule depth.
   function ODC_Available (Value : Channel_Capability) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: NUC_Available
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Inspect the upstream optical-distortion-map availability report, not an
   --  implementation of optical-distortion correction in this bridge.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return True when the stored availability report is set.
   function NUC_Available (Value : Channel_Capability) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Metadata_Capability_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Inspect the upstream report that the MFA performs nonuniformity
   --  correction; no correction algorithm is implemented by this accessor.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return True when the stored provider report is set.
   function Metadata_Capability_Count (Value : Channel_Capability) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Metadata_Capability_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count stored metadata advertisements. Provider snapshots reflect native
   --  set iteration; local constructor input is not deduplicated.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of stored metadata entries.
   function Metadata_Capability_At
     (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Metadata_Capability;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Has_Metadata_Capability
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read a metadata advertisement, not a callback registration. An index
   --  beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based stored position, not the enum's numeric value.
   --  @return Metadata category at that position.
   function Has_Metadata_Capability
     (Value : Channel_Capability; Item : Metadata_Capability) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Image_Band_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Test stored-vector membership without contacting the provider. Upstream
   --  relates advertisement to registration support, but this test registers
   --  nothing and does not establish a corresponding implemented Ada API.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Item Metadata callback category to seek.
   --  @return True if an equal category occurs in the stored vector.
   function Image_Band_Count (Value : Channel_Capability) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Image_Band_Index_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count image-band map entries, not individual spectral bands.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of stored map entries available by positive position.
   function Image_Band_Index_At
     (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Image_Band_Info_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the map key at a positional index. Provider map iteration is ordered
   --  by key; keys need not be contiguous or equal their vector positions.
   --  An index beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based map-entry position, not the desired map key.
   --  @return Stored band key, widened from upstream unsigned 8 bits for provider snapshots.
   function Image_Band_Info_Count (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Image_Band_Info_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count spectral descriptions associated with one stored map entry.
   --  An out-of-range map-entry position raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based map-entry position, not the upstream map key.
   --  @return Length of the selected entry's band-description vector.
   function Image_Band_Info_At
     (Value : Channel_Capability; Band_Index, Info_Index : Positive) return Band_Info;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Nav_Frame_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy one spectral description using two positional indices. Either index
   --  exceeding the corresponding vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Band_Index One-based map-entry position, despite the parameter name; not the upstream map key.
   --  @param Info_Index One-based position in that entry's ordered description vector.
   --  @return Owned category and vacuum wavelength bounds in meters, without normalization.
   function Nav_Frame_Count (Value : Channel_Capability) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Nav_Frame_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Count advertised navigation frames; upstream permits an empty vector
   --  when internal sensor navigation data is not provided.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of stored navigation-frame reports.
   function Nav_Frame_At
     (Value : Channel_Capability; Index : Positive) return Coordinate_System_Type;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: View
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read a frame category in provider vector order, which upstream relates
   --  to frame-header navigation-state order. No transformation is performed.
   --  An index beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Value Owned capability snapshot to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based position in the navigation-frame vector.
   --  @return Reported coordinate-system category at that position.

   --  Safe common Channel facade (Task 032B2).
   --
   --  A View is created only by a typed family's As_Channel conversion:
   --  C2.As_Channel, Image.As_Channel, Health_Status.As_Channel,
   --  Instrumentation.As_Channel, or Track.As_Channel. It is a controlled
   --  owner of exactly one native weak common Channel view. It does NOT own
   --  the typed family state, Session, provider Channel, Control, or provider
   --  library: after the typed owner and its Session close, common operations
   --  on a still-open View raise Provider_Error, while Close still succeeds.
   --  Closing or finalizing a View never closes, enables, disables, or
   --  detaches the typed source owner and never cancels pending requests.
   --  Operations on one View and Close of that same View must be externally
   --  serialized; distinct Views need no serialization.
   subtype View is AMS.MEL.IR.Channel_View;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Limited controlled owner of a weak native view obtained from a typed
   --  family's channel conversion. It retains neither typed resource, Session,
   --  provider Channel, Control nor library. A present handle can outlive its
   --  target; even a live target must pass its lifecycle check for operations.
   --  Closing this view never closes its typed owner or cancels requests.
   --  Serialize operations and closure of the same view externally; distinct
   --  views do not require serialization with one another.
   function Is_Open (Channel : View) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Test local handle presence only; this neither locks the weak target nor
   --  proves that it still exists or admits operations.
   --  @param Channel Weak view to inspect without contacting the provider.
   --  @return True when the native view handle is present, even if its target expired.
   procedure Close (Channel : in out View);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Idempotently destroy only the weak view and clear its handle. The typed
   --  owner and independently admitted requests are unaffected. Unexpected
   --  native failure raises a provider error; finalization is non-raising.
   --  @param Channel View to close; externally serialize against its operations.

   type Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Terminal upstream result category, not submission status or evidence of
   --  physical command execution. Native/provider failures raise exceptions.
   --  @enum Success A future produced its payload; a Return payload can still be Fail.
   --  @enum Rejected The future produced an explicit upstream ErrorOr error.
   type Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Command_Return
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Explicit upstream rejection codes mapped to native values 0..8. These
   --  are distinct from bridge admission exhaustion and provider exceptions.
   --  @enum None Upstream no-error code, native value 0; preserved if reported in an error.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, native value 1.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, native value 2.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, native value 3.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, native value 4.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, native value 5.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, native value 6.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, native value 7.
   --  @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, native value 8.
   type Command_Return is (Return_Success, Bad_Pointer, Fail, Not_Supported, Not_Implemented);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Return_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Payload of a successfully completed Return future, mapped to values 0..4.
   --  Every literal is a payload under Success, not an explicit rejection.
   --  @enum Return_Success Upstream Return::Success, native value 0.
   --  @enum Bad_Pointer Upstream Return::BadPointer, native value 1.
   --  @enum Fail Upstream Return::Fail, native value 2; successful future completion, not command success.
   --  @enum Not_Supported Upstream Return::NotSupported, native value 3.
   --  @enum Not_Implemented Upstream Return::NotImplemented, native value 4.

   --  Submissions are valid while the family's common lifecycle admits
   --  requests (C2/Health/Instrumentation/Track: Attached or Enabled; Image:
   --  Attached or Running). Session admission refusal raises
   --  AMS.MEL.Resource_Exhausted; any other submission failure, including an
   --  expired or closed View, raises Provider_Error. An admitted request owns
   --  the native family graph independently of the View, typed owner, and
   --  Session. Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR; timeout never
   --  cancels or consumes a request, and a later Wait returns the identical
   --  cached terminal result. Close must not race Wait on the same request.
   type Return_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Send_Keep_Alive
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Limited controlled observer of one admitted Return future. Pending work
   --  retains its native family graph independently of this owner, the view,
   --  typed owner and Session. Close is not cancellation or direct release of a
   --  pending admission permit. Finalization closes without raising. Serialize
   --  explicit Close against Wait on the same request.
   function Send_Keep_Alive (Channel : View) return Return_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Submit the inherited keep-alive operation, not a typed mode command.
   --  C2, Health, Instrumentation and Track admit it while Attached or Enabled;
   --  Image admits it while Attached or Running. Expired targets or ineligible
   --  states raise a provider error. Session-wide admission refusal raises
   --  the resource-exhaustion exception; other submission failures raise a provider error.
   --  Successful submission does not establish future or command success.
   --  @param Channel Open weak view of an eligible typed resource.
   --  @return Admitted request whose worker independently retains provider lifetime.
   function Is_Open (Request : Return_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Return_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Inspect public request-handle presence, not completion or provider state.
   --  @param Request Return request observer to inspect.
   --  @return True until explicit closure or finalization clears the handle.
   type Return_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Status
Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the stored terminal category without contacting the provider.
   --  @param Result Owned result from a Return request wait.
   --  @return Success for a payload or Rejected for an explicit upstream error.
   function Value (Result : Return_Result) return Command_Return
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read the Return payload. The declared precondition requires Success;
   --  the body only returns its stored field and adds no outcome check when
   --  assertion checking is disabled. Do not use it on a rejection.
   --  @param Result Successful Return result to inspect.
   --  @return Provider Return payload, which may be Fail or another non-success value.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Return_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Read an explicit rejection code. The declared precondition requires
   --  Rejected; the body does not independently enforce that condition.
   --  @param Result Rejected Return result to inspect.
   --  @return Preserved upstream error category, not a bridge failure status.
   function Description (Result : Return_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy the rejection diagnostic. The declared precondition requires
   --  Rejected; the body itself simply copies stored text.
   --  @param Result Rejected Return result to inspect.
   --  @return Complete owned rejection text, not a truncated fixed-buffer prefix.
   function Wait (Request : Return_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Return_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Await completion or return the cached terminal result on repeated waits.
   --  Timeout raises the inherited timeout exception without consuming or
   --  cancelling work. Other native/provider failures raise a provider error;
   --  explicit rejection is a result, not that exception. Completion releases
   --  pending accounting through the worker, not through observer closure.
   --  @param Request Open Return request; must not race its Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls for completion.
   --  @return Owned terminal payload or explicit rejection, cached repeatably.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Return_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Comms_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Idempotently release the public observer, not the provider work. Pending
   --  work still retains its graph and admission permit until worker completion
   --  or safe-retention fallback. Unexpected native failure raises a provider error.
   --  @param Request Observer to close; externally serialize against Wait.

   type Comms_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Submit_Comms_Test
Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Submit the inherited communications test while the typed family admits
   --  common operations: Attached/Enabled for C2, Health, Instrumentation and
   --  Track; Attached/Running for Image. Session admission exhaustion raises
   --  the resource-exhaustion exception. Closed/expired views, ineligible resources and other
   --  native failures raise a provider error. Submission is not completion.
   --  @param Channel Open weak view of an eligible typed channel.
   --  @param Channel_ID Unsigned communications-test channel selector, not a UCI identity.
   --  @param Command_ID Command correlation identifier copied with all 32 bits.
   --  @param Request_ID Communications-test correlation identifier copied with all 32 bits.
   --  @return Admitted observer; pending provider work independently retains lifetime.
   function Is_Open (Request : Comms_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Comms_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Inspect observer-handle presence without polling the future.
   --  @param Request Communications-test observer to inspect.
   --  @return True for a present handle, whether pending or terminal.
   type Comms_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Status
Report
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Inspect the stored communications-test terminal category.
   --  @param Result Owned communications-test result to inspect.
   --  @return Success for a report or Rejected for an upstream ErrorOr error.
   function Report (Result : Comms_Result) return Comms_Test_Report
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy the report. The declared precondition requires Success; the body
   --  returns its stored field without an independent outcome check.
   --  @param Result Successful communications-test result.
   --  @return Owned command/request correlation identifiers reported by the provider.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Comms_Result) return Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Description
Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition. The body
   --  returns stored text without independently checking the outcome.
   --  @param Result Rejected communications-test result.
   --  @return Complete owned diagnostic, including text beyond the initial native buffer.
   function Wait (Request : Comms_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Comms_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Wait for a report or explicit rejection; repeated terminal waits return
   --  the cached result. Timeout raises the inherited timeout exception and is
   --  not cancellation. Closed handles and other native/provider failures raise
   --  a provider error. No callback registration is performed by this wait.
   --  @param Request Open communications-test observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned terminal report or rejection, independent of provider storage.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Comms_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.name: Capabilities
AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.signature:
--  Idempotently close the observer, without cancelling the future or directly
   --  freeing its pending admission permit. Independent work retention remains.
   --  Unexpected native failure raises a provider error; finalization is non-raising.
   --  @param Request Observer to close, externally serialized against Wait.

   --  Returns an owned snapshot that remains valid after View Close, typed
   --  owner Close, Session Close, and provider unload.
   function Capabilities (Channel : View) return Channel_Capability;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Metadata_Stream
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature: type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Limited owner of public health metadata consumption. Channel-owned native callback state
   --  survives public metadata Close; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. Serialize
   --  operations on the same Ada owner.
   function Open (Channel : Health_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Stream;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Registers the six bound health/status callbacks on an attached or enabled channel, once per
   --  channel including a failed attempt. Registration may synchronously produce events. Failure
   --  publishes no metadata owner; partial registrations retain inactive state because upstream
   --  has no unregister operation. All kinds share one bounded drop-incoming queue ordered by
   --  successful enqueue, not timestamps or simultaneous callback entry order.
   --  @param Channel Attached or enabled owning typed health channel.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Maximum queued events across all six kinds; defaults to sixteen.
   --  @return Limited owner of public metadata polling.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Invalid/closed channel, repeated registration attempt, provider
   --  registration failure/exception or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Failure_Level
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Tests local public metadata-handle ownership, not callback activity or provider health.
   --  @param Stream Metadata owner to inspect.
   --  @return True while its local native handle is nonnull.

   type Failure_Level is (NA, Critical, Major, Parametric, Informational, Available, Not_Present);

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: CSCI_Mode
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider failure-state category, not a numeric severity scale or bitmask. Descriptions do
   --  not invent thresholds absent from the pinned interface.
   --  @enum NA Upstream NA category; no further meaning is specified in the pinned enum.
   --  @enum Critical Upstream critical failure, explicitly annotated as no heartbeat message.
   --  @enum Major Provider major failure category; no threshold is specified upstream.
   --  @enum Parametric Provider parametric failure category; no threshold is specified upstream.
   --  @enum Informational Provider informational category.
   --  @enum Available No failure, as explicitly described upstream.
   --  @enum Not_Present Subsystem is not physically or simulated-ly installed.
   type CSCI_Mode is
     (Unknown,
      Unused,
      Initialization,
      Maintenance,
      Idle,
      Operational,
      VSA,
      Quick_Look,
      Track,
      Imaging,
      Noise);

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_Dependency
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Reported subsystem software configuration mode, preserved without commanding a mode
   --  transition. The pinned enum does not define operational criteria for these modes.
   --  @enum Unknown Unknown reported mode.
   --  @enum Unused Unused mode.
   --  @enum Initialization Initialization mode.
   --  @enum Maintenance Maintenance mode.
   --  @enum Idle Idle mode.
   --  @enum Operational Operational mode.
   --  @enum VSA Upstream VSA mode; the acronym is not expanded by the pinned declaration.
   --  @enum Quick_Look Quick-look mode.
   --  @enum Track Track mode.
   --  @enum Imaging Imaging mode.
   --  @enum Noise Noise mode.
   type Subsystem_Dependency is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_ID
Criticality
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider subsystem identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   --  @param Value Owned dependency to inspect.
   --  @return Provider subsystem identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   function Criticality (Value : Subsystem_Dependency) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Failure
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   --  @param Value Owned dependency to inspect.
   --  @return Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   function Failure (Value : Subsystem_Dependency) return Failure_Level;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Version
Subsystem_CSCI
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Four unsigned subsystem software-version components. This is neither the bridge ABI version
   --  nor provider API/library version; no packed encoding or source code scheme is imposed.
   --  @field Source Raw upstream version source component; its encoding is not specified.
   --  @field Major_Revision Reported major revision component.
   --  @field Minor_Revision Reported minor revision component.
   --  @field Engineering_Revision Reported engineering revision component.
   type Subsystem_CSCI is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: CSCI_Name
Mode
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Independent Ada string containing the validated provider software-item name.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Independent Ada string containing the validated provider software-item name.
   function Mode (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return CSCI_Mode;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Version_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Reported software configuration mode; no transition is performed.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Reported software configuration mode; no transition is performed.
   function Version_Value (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return Version;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Criticality
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Copied four-component subsystem software version.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Copied four-component subsystem software version.
   function Criticality (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Failure
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   function Failure (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return Failure_Level;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: BIT_Report
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Reported failure category without bridge reclassification.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Reported failure category without bridge reclassification.
   function BIT_Report (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Connection_Established
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider counter incremented when BIT status changes, enabling a pull pattern; not an actual
   --  BIT report payload.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Provider counter incremented when BIT status changes, enabling a pull pattern; not
   --  an actual BIT report payload.
   function Connection_Established (Value : Subsystem_CSCI) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_Status
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider connection-established indication; no connectivity probe is performed.
   --  @param Value Owned software configuration item to inspect.
   --  @return Provider connection-established indication; no connectivity probe is performed.
   type Subsystem_Status is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
