--  Owned subsystem-status snapshot with separately preserved reported counts and copied
   --  dependency/CSCI sequences. Actual lengths, not reported counts, bound indexed access. Order
   --  and duplicates are preserved.
   function Subsystem_ID (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Criticality
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider subsystem identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Provider subsystem identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   function Criticality (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Status_Sequence_Number
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Raw provider criticality value; no numeric severity scale or bitmask is established
   --  upstream.
   function Status_Sequence_Number (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Failure
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Raw provider status sequence number; no monotonicity or wrap policy is imposed.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Raw provider status sequence number; no monotonicity or wrap policy is imposed.
   function Failure (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Failure_Level;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Reported_Subsystem_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Reported failure category without bridge reclassification.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Reported failure category without bridge reclassification.
   function Reported_Subsystem_Count (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider-reported dependency count, not the copied vector length.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported dependency count, not the copied vector length.
   function Subsystem_Count (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Actual copied dependency-sequence length.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Actual copied dependency-sequence length.
   function Subsystem_At (Value : Subsystem_Status; Index : Positive) return Subsystem_Dependency;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Reported_CSCI_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Dependency at the one-based copied-sequence index.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status whose dependency sequence is inspected.
   --  @param Index One-based position; raises Constraint Error beyond the actual copied length.
   --  @return Dependency at the one-based copied-sequence index.
   function Reported_CSCI_Count (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: CSCI_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider-reported CSCI count, not the copied vector length.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported CSCI count, not the copied vector length.
   function CSCI_Count (Value : Subsystem_Status) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: CSCI_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Actual copied CSCI-sequence length.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @return Actual copied CSCI-sequence length.
   function CSCI_At (Value : Subsystem_Status; Index : Positive) return Subsystem_CSCI;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Metadata_Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Software configuration item at the one-based copied-sequence index.
   --  @param Value Owned subsystem status to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based position; raises Constraint Error beyond the actual copied length.
   --  @return Software configuration item at the one-based copied-sequence index.

   type Metadata_Kind is
     (MFA_Status_Event,
      BIT_Status_Event,
      Subsystem_Status_Event,
      Discrete_Status_Event,
      Security_Audit_Event,
      MFA_Status_Detailed_Event);

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Metadata_Event
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Discriminator for six bound health callback families. Canonical Status types define shared
   --  status/BIT/fault/security semantics; this package does not redefine them.
   --  @enum MFA_Status_Event Canonical Status MFA status snapshot.
   --  @enum BIT_Status_Event Canonical Status BIT status, completed/active tests and fault
   --  information.
   --  @enum Subsystem_Status_Event Subsystem dependencies and software configuration items.
   --  @enum Discrete_Status_Event Canonical Status discrete name/value sequence.
   --  @enum Security_Audit_Event Canonical Status security-audit record and its active event
   --  variant.
   --  @enum MFA_Status_Detailed_Event Canonical Status detailed MFA name/value sequence.
   type Metadata_Event (Event_Kind : Metadata_Kind := MFA_Status_Event) is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned discriminated event copied from native metadata. All nested collections and strings
   --  are Ada-owned and survive metadata/channel/Session closure. Call only the accessor
   --  corresponding to the discriminant; see each declared precondition.
   --  @field Event_Kind Selects the active payload; defaults to the MFA status alternative.
   function Kind (Event : Metadata_Event) return Metadata_Kind;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: MFA_Status_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns the public event discriminant without interpreting its payload.
   --  @param Event Owned event to inspect.
   --  @return Active metadata kind.
   function MFA_Status_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Status.MFA_Status
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = MFA_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: BIT_Status_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the MFA Status Event kind. Requires Kind equal to MFA Status
   --  Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the body directly
   --  selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is also subject to
   --  Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error conversion.
   --  Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.
   function BIT_Status_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Status.BIT_Status
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = BIT_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Subsystem_Status_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the BIT Status Event kind. Requires Kind equal to BIT Status
   --  Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the body directly
   --  selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is also subject to
   --  Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error conversion.
   --  Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.
   function Subsystem_Status_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Subsystem_Status
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = Subsystem_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Discrete_Status_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the Subsystem Status Event kind. Requires Kind equal to
   --  Subsystem Status Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the
   --  body directly selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is
   --  also subject to Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error
   --  conversion. Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.
   function Discrete_Status_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Status.Discrete_Status
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = Discrete_Status_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Security_Audit_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the Discrete Status Event kind. Requires Kind equal to Discrete
   --  Status Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the body
   --  directly selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is also
   --  subject to Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error
   --  conversion. Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.
   function Security_Audit_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Status.Security_Audit_Record
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = Security_Audit_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: MFA_Status_Detailed_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the Security Audit Event kind. Requires Kind equal to Security
   --  Audit Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the body
   --  directly selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is also
   --  subject to Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error
   --  conversion. Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.
   function MFA_Status_Detailed_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Status.MFA_Status_Detailed
   with Pre => Kind (Event) = MFA_Status_Detailed_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns an owned payload for the MFA Status Detailed Event kind. Requires Kind equal to MFA
   --  Status Detailed Event. Enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation; the
   --  body directly selects the discriminated component, so a wrong-kind component selection is
   --  also subject to Ada discriminant checking (Constraint Error), not a bridge Provider Error
   --  conversion. Consult canonical AMS.MEL.Status for shared data semantics.
   --  @param Event Owned event whose kind satisfies the declared precondition.
   --  @return Independent payload value of the corresponding event kind.

   function Receive
     (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Metadata_Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Dequeues one native event, deeply copies its active payload to Ada and closes the temporary
   --  native event before returning. Existing queued events can drain after channel closure or
   --  callback failure; an empty inactive queue raises Stream Stopped, while an empty failed queue
   --  raises Provider Error. Provider callbacks never call Ada. Malformed records are discarded;
   --  exceptions during callback copying/allocation mark the metadata stream failed rather than
   --  being silently counted as a malformed record.
   --  @param Stream Open public metadata owner; externally serialize use and Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Ada-owned discriminated event with independent nested data.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed owner, failed callback state, invalid conversion or native
   --  failure.
   type Metadata_Counters is record
      Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Saturating native callback counters across all six kinds; not counts of successful Ada
   --  receives.
   --  @field Events_Received Observed callback entries, including entries after consumption
   --  becomes inactive.
   --  @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid copied incoming events dropped at queue capacity;
   --  queued events are not evicted.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null, unknown-enum, invalid-text or otherwise unsupported
   --  events rejected by conversion. Callback exceptions instead mark the stream failed.
   function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies the current callback counter snapshot without dequeuing events.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata-consumption owner.
   --  @return Independent saturating counter values.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed owner or native query failure.
   procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Health_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Typed HealthAndStatus attachment, explicit enablement and common-channel integration. The
   --  child metadata package binds six health/status callback families using the canonical
   --  AMS.MEL.Status data types. This package does not duplicate inherited common channel
   --  services.

   type Health_Config is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Create_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Owned configuration for attaching a typed HealthAndStatus channel; constructing it does not
   --  contact a provider.
   function Create_Config
     (Channel_ID : UCI_ID; Platform_ID : UCI_ID; Sensor_Location : Component_Location)
      return Health_Config;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Health_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Builds an independent health-channel attachment configuration without enabling or
   --  registering metadata.
   --  @param Channel_ID Channel identity to pass to the provider.
   --  @param Platform_ID Platform identity to pass to the provider.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Component location with meter offsets and location identity.
   --  @return Owned configuration retaining all supplied identity and location values.

   type Health_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Limited typed owner, initially closed. Open attaches; Enable is explicit. Native state
   --  retains the Session/provider while this child needs it. Closing the public Session does not
   --  invalidate an existing channel. A weak common view does not keep this typed owner alive.
   --  Finalization attempts non-raising cleanup; failed detach can deliberately retain native
   --  resources for safety. Serialize lifecycle operations on the same Ada owner.
   function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Health_Config) return Health_Channel;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Attaches a HealthAndStatus channel, verifies its dynamic type and advertised channel
   --  capability, and publishes an owner only on success. Does not enable it. Metadata
   --  registration and capability queries are allowed while attached, before Enable. Native
   --  validation requires UTF-8 identity/location text without embedded NUL. Failed
   --  attachment/type validation attempts cleanup; uncertain detach retains the provider graph.
   --  @param Parent Open IR Session whose provider supplies the child channel.
   --  @param Config Complete attachment identity and sensor location.
   --  @return Attached, not yet enabled, limited health-channel owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed Session, invalid configuration text, provider
   --  attachment/capability/type failure or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Channel : Health_Channel) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Enable
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Tests only local typed-channel handle ownership, not whether the channel is enabled or
   --  provider operations will succeed.
   --  @param Channel Typed owner to inspect.
   --  @return True when its local native handle is nonnull.
   procedure Enable (Channel : in out Health_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Capabilities
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Explicitly enables the attached provider channel. Repeated Enable after success is a no-op;
   --  failure marks native lifecycle failed and requires cleanup rather than implying enabled
   --  service. Metadata may be registered before Enable.
   --  @param Channel Attached owner to enable, or already enabled owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed owner, provider rejection/exception or native
   --  failure.
   function Capabilities (Channel : Health_Channel) return IR.Channel.Channel_Capability;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: As_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Copies common capabilities while the channel is attached or enabled. Returned arrays and
   --  text are Ada-owned and do not retain the typed owner.
   --  @param Channel Attached or enabled health channel.
   --  @return Independent common channel capability snapshot.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Invalid lifecycle, provider capability failure or native
   --  conversion failure.
   function As_Channel (Channel : Health_Channel) return IR.Channel.View;

AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Health_Status.signature:
--  Creates a weak common Channel view while attached or enabled. Inherited KeepAlive, CommsTest
   --  and common capability services use common Channel support, not duplicated health methods.
   --  This view neither owns nor keeps the typed Health Channel alive; closing it does not close
   --  that owner.
   --  @param Channel Live attached or enabled typed channel.
   --  @return New weak common channel view.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed owner or native view creation failure.
   procedure Close (Channel : in out Health_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Metadata_Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned polling of four image metadata callback families: bad pixels, line-of-sight report,
   --  line-of-sight Euler and navigation response. Optional LineOfSightQuaternion,
   --  OpticalDistortionMap and other upstream callbacks are not bound here. Payloads are copied at
   --  the native callback boundary and again into safe Ada values; no provider pointer is exposed.

   type Metadata_Kind is
     (Bad_Pixel_List_Event,
      Line_Of_Sight_Report_Event,
      Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Event,
      Navigation_Response_Event);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Bad_Pixel_Reason
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  The four image callback families bound by this package; other optional upstream metadata
   --  callbacks are not exposed.
   --  @enum Bad_Pixel_List_Event Owned bad-pixel defect list.
   --  @enum Line_Of_Sight_Report_Event Owned sensor-relative pointing report.
   --  @enum Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Event Owned aperture line-of-sight Euler data.
   --  @enum Navigation_Response_Event Owned navigation acknowledgement; distinct from
   --  request-handle completion.
   type Bad_Pixel_Reason is (Unknown);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Bad_Pixel
Bad_Pixel_List
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  One copied provider-reported bad pixel; coordinates are retained without renumbering or
   --  defect correction.
   --  @field Row Reported pixel row coordinate; the pinned header does not establish a
   --  coordinate-origin convention.
   --  @field Column Reported pixel column coordinate, without bridge renumbering.
   --  @field Reason Reported supported defect reason; unknown enum values cause event rejection.
   type Bad_Pixel_List is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Azimuth_Elevation
Line_Of_Sight_Report
Line_Of_Sight_Euler
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned sensor pointing report copied without transformations. Validity bits are preserved but
   --  their positions are not defined by the pinned header.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Provider system time in nanoseconds; clock and epoch are unspecified.
   --  @field Pointing_Angle Azimuth/elevation angles relative to the sensor, in radians.
   --  @field Pointing_Angle_Rates Provider pointing-rate components represented by AzEl; the
   --  pinned report does not explicitly establish rate units.
   --  @field At_Speed Provider indication that the MFA is at scan speed, subject to the validity
   --  field.
   --  @field In_Tolerance Provider indication that the MFA is within desired-position tolerance,
   --  subject to the validity field.
   --  @field Platform_Attitude Platform Euler attitude; consult the canonical Status Euler
   --  description and the validity field.
   --  @field Validity_Flag_Bitfield Raw validity value for at-speed, in-tolerance and
   --  platform-attitude fields; no bit positions are invented.
   --  @field Image_Rotation_Rad Provider image rotation in radians; no rotation is applied by the
   --  bridge.
   type Line_Of_Sight_Euler is record
      System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer;
      Attitude       : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler;
      Attitude_Rates : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Navigation_Response
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned aperture line-of-sight Euler angles and rates at their time of validity.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Line-of-sight time of validity in nanoseconds; no clock or epoch is
   --  specified.
   --  @field Attitude Euler angles describing aperture line of sight, in radians.
   --  @field Attitude_Rates Euler angle rates describing aperture line-of-sight rate, in radians
   --  per second.
   subtype Navigation_Response is AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Navigation_Response;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Reported_Size
Reported_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider-reported bad-pixel list size in bytes; not recomputed from copied entries.
   --  @param Value Owned bad-pixel list to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported bad-pixel list size in bytes; not recomputed from copied entries.
   function Reported_Count (Value : Bad_Pixel_List) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Pixel_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Provider-reported bad-pixel count; may differ from the copied collection length.
   --  @param Value Owned bad-pixel list to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported bad-pixel count; may differ from the copied collection length.
   function Pixel_Count (Value : Bad_Pixel_List) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Pixel_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Actual length of the copied bad-pixel collection, used for indexing.
   --  @param Value Owned bad-pixel list to inspect.
   --  @return Actual length of the copied bad-pixel collection, used for indexing.
   function Pixel_At (Value : Bad_Pixel_List; Index : Positive) return Bad_Pixel;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Metadata_Counters
Metadata_Stream
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Saturating unsigned callback counters shared across the four kinds; these count callback
   --  activity, not successful Ada Receive calls.
   --  @field Events_Received Callback entries observed, incremented even when consumption has
   --  become inactive.
   --  @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid copied incoming events discarded because the bounded
   --  queue is full; existing events are retained.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null, unsupported or malformed events and copying/allocation
   --  failures rejected at the callback boundary.
   type Metadata_Stream is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Metadata_Event
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Limited owner of public metadata consumption. Callback state belongs to the image stream and
   --  can outlive this public owner. Close deactivates consumption, not provider callback
   --  unregistration; finalization attempts non-raising cleanup. Serialize operations on the same
   --  Ada owner.
   type Metadata_Event is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Ada-owned tagged snapshot of one metadata event. Native temporary storage is closed before
   --  Receive returns; the value survives metadata stream, image stream and Session closure. No
   --  borrowed provider pointer escapes.
   function Open
     (Stream : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Queue_Capacity : Positive) return Metadata_Stream;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Registers all four supported callbacks on an attached or running image stream, once per
   --  image stream, including after registration failure. Prefer registration before Start to
   --  avoid missing early events. A failed or unsupported registration raises Provider Error and
   --  publishes no metadata owner; already registered callbacks retain inactive state until
   --  provider-channel destruction because upstream supplies no unregister operation. All kinds
   --  share one bounded drop-incoming queue, ordered by successful enqueue under its mutex, not by
   --  timestamps or concurrent callback entry order. Closing metadata does not close the image
   --  stream.
   --  @param Stream Owning image stream, not stopping, stopped or failed.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued events across all four kinds.
   --  @return Limited metadata-consumption owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible stream, repeated registration attempt,
   --  registration rejection/exception or native failure.
   function Receive
     (Stream : Metadata_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Dequeues one event and copies all active payload into Ada ownership before releasing its
   --  native temporary. Already queued events can drain after logical image Stop/Close; once
   --  empty, stopped consumption raises Stream Stopped. Provider callbacks never invoke Ada code.
   --  No automatic registration or optional callback binding is performed.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata-consumption owner; externally serialize access and Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Independent owned event of one of the four supported kinds.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed metadata owner, invalid converted event, or native
   --  operation failure.
   function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Stream) return Metadata_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies the current native counters without consuming queued events. Values saturate at the
   --  maximum counter value.
   --  @param Stream Open public metadata owner.
   --  @return Owned snapshot of callback counters.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed owner or native query failure.
   procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Idempotently closes public metadata consumption and wakes native waiters. Does not
   --  unregister provider callbacks, close the image stream, or guarantee immediate callback
   --  quiescence. Channel-owned callback state survives for safe later provider calls until
   --  channel destruction. Automatic finalization attempts cleanup without raising.
   --  @param Stream Metadata owner to close; serialize against Receive and other uses.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native close failed.
   function Kind (Event : Metadata_Event) return Metadata_Kind;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Bad_Pixel_List_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Returns the kind of this owned event.
   --  @param Event Event snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Discriminator selecting the applicable payload accessor.
   function Bad_Pixel_List_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Bad_Pixel_List;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Line_Of_Sight_Report_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies the bad-pixel list payload from an event of the corresponding kind. The body
   --  explicitly raises Provider Error for an incorrect kind; these accessors do not rely on
   --  declared preconditions.
   --  @param Event Owned event with the corresponding kind.
   --  @return Independent owned bad-pixel list value.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Event kind does not match this accessor.
   function Line_Of_Sight_Report_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Line_Of_Sight_Report;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies the line-of-sight report payload from an event of the corresponding kind. The body
   --  explicitly raises Provider Error for an incorrect kind; these accessors do not rely on
   --  declared preconditions.
   --  @param Event Owned event with the corresponding kind.
   --  @return Independent owned line-of-sight report value.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Event kind does not match this accessor.
   function Line_Of_Sight_Euler_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Line_Of_Sight_Euler;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.name: Navigation_Response_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies the line-of-sight Euler payload from an event of the corresponding kind. The body
   --  explicitly raises Provider Error for an incorrect kind; these accessors do not rely on
   --  declared preconditions.
   --  @param Event Owned event with the corresponding kind.
   --  @return Independent owned line-of-sight Euler value.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Event kind does not match this accessor.
   function Navigation_Response_Value (Event : Metadata_Event) return Navigation_Response;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Full_Image_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature: type Full_Image_Type is (Staring, Scanning, Reserved13);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Image_Flag
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider image collection category; reserved values are preserved, not interpreted.
   --  @enum Staring Staring image collection.
   --  @enum Scanning Scanning image collection.
   --  @enum Reserved13 Reserved upstream image category; no additional behavior is assigned.
   type Image_Flag is (Scan_First, Scan_Last, Stare_Snapshot, Stare_Rolling);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Directional
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Ordered scan/stare annotations supplied by the provider; duplicates are preserved.
   --  @enum Scan_First First image chunk in a scan.
   --  @enum Scan_Last Last image chunk in a scan.
   --  @enum Stare_Snapshot Snapshot capture of a staring image.
   --  @enum Stare_Rolling Rolling-shutter capture of a staring image.
   type Directional is record
      X, Y, Z : Long_Float;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Quaternion
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Three provider-supplied directional components. Units and reference frame belong to the
   --  containing field; the bridge performs no transformation.
   --  @field X X-axis component in the containing field reference frame.
   --  @field Y Y-axis component in the containing field reference frame.
   --  @field Z Z-axis component in the containing field reference frame.
   type Quaternion is record
      X, Y, Z, W : Long_Float;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Nav_Error
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider quaternion in X, Y, Z, W component order. The bridge neither normalizes the value
   --  nor checks numerical validity.
   --  @field X X component of the quaternion.
   --  @field Y Y component of the quaternion.
   --  @field Z Z component of the quaternion.
   --  @field W W component of the quaternion.
   type Nav_Error is record
      X, Y, Z, W : Long_Float;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Uncertainty
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider error values for a vector, Euler orientation or quaternion. No statistical
   --  confidence, covariance construction or universal component units are established by the
   --  pinned interface.
   --  @field X First error component of the associated representation.
   --  @field Y Second error component of the associated representation.
   --  @field Z Third error component of the associated representation.
   --  @field W Fourth component, used upstream for quaternion error only; preserved without
   --  interpretation.
   type Uncertainty is record
      Sensor_Uncertainties, Platform_Uncertainties : Interfaces.Unsigned_32;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Contributing_Sensor
Orientation_Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Identity and physical location of the sensor contributing this image.
   --  @field Location Sensor component location, including meter offsets and owned location
   --  identity strings.
   --  @field Sensor_ID Provider sensor identifier; all 32 bits are preserved.
   type Orientation_Kind is (Euler_Orientation, Quaternion_Orientation);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Orientation
Sensor_Inertial_State
Coordinate_System
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider inertial state associated with image collection. FrameHeader describes one state
   --  for non-TDI imagery and a per-column sequence for TDI; the bridge preserves the actual
   --  sequence without imposing those lengths.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Provider system time in nanoseconds; no clock or epoch is assigned by
   --  the bridge.
   --  @field Q_XYZW Quaternion from sensor coordinates to local-level North/East/Down.
   --  @field Q_ECEF_XYZW Quaternion from North/East/Down to Earth-centered Earth-fixed
   --  coordinates.
   --  @field Sensor_Position Sensor position in ECEF coordinates, in meters.
   --  @field Sensor_Velocity Sensor velocity in ECEF coordinates, in meters per second.
   --  @field Uncertainty Uninterpreted sensor and platform navigation uncertainty values.
   type Coordinate_System is (LLA, ECEF, NED_Platform, NED_Sensor);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Sensor_Nav_State
Full_Frame
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Copied internal sensor navigation state at collection time. Components and orientation
   --  alternatives are preserved independently. The pinned SensorNavState header does not
   --  establish universal component or derivative units; the bridge performs no interpolation,
   --  coordinate transformation or error estimation.
   --  @field Position Reported position in the identified coordinate system.
   --  @field Velocity Reported velocity in the identified coordinate system.
   --  @field Acceleration Reported acceleration in the identified coordinate system.
   --  @field Position_Error Provider position error components, without statistical
   --  interpretation.
   --  @field Velocity_Error Provider velocity error components, without statistical
   --  interpretation.
   --  @field Acceleration_Error Provider acceleration error components, without statistical
   --  interpretation.
   --  @field Orientation Reported orientation with its own representation discriminant.
   --  @field Orientation_Error Provider error components for the reported orientation.
   --  @field Orientation_Velocity Reported orientation derivative with its own representation
   --  discriminant.
   --  @field Orientation_Velocity_Error Provider error components for orientation velocity.
   --  @field Orientation_Acceleration Reported second orientation derivative with its own
   --  representation discriminant.
   --  @field Orientation_Acceleration_Error Provider error components for orientation
   --  acceleration.
   --  @field Coordinate_System Identifies the reference frame of this state; no conversion is
   --  performed.

   type Full_Frame is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Capabilities
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Ada-owned complete frame snapshot: copied header, ordered flags, inertial/navigation
   --  sequences and pixel bytes. Unlike the smaller legacy IR Frame, this retains
   --  contributing-sensor identity and detailed navigation metadata. Returned snapshots survive
   --  stream, Session and provider closure.
   function Capabilities
     (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Channel_Capability;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: As_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Copies the common channel capability snapshot while the image stream is open. No returned
   --  value retains the stream. Native failures are mapped through the IR submission exception
   --  policy.
   --  @param Object Image stream whose capability is queried.
   --  @return Ada-owned capability snapshot.
   function As_Channel (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Creates a weak common Channel view of the open stream. Raises Provider Error if closed or
   --  view creation fails. The view neither keeps the stream alive nor stops or closes it; use
   --  common Channel support for inherited services.
   --  @param Object Open image stream to view.
   --  @return New weak common channel view.
   function Receive
     (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Full_Frame;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: System_Time_NS
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Receives a complete frame by copying header metadata and the entire pixel payload into
   --  Ada-owned storage, then closing the temporary native snapshot before return. The result
   --  survives stream, Session and provider closure. Pixels makes another independent copy. This
   --  exposes more metadata than legacy IR Receive, but performs no pixel decoding or conversion.
   --  Only Mono8 single-band nonempty dimensions and validated host-buffer spans are accepted;
   --  malformed provider frames are discarded by the native callback. At most one receive/acquire
   --  consumer may use a stream at once. Externally serialize lifecycle operations on a shared Ada
   --  owner. Timeout does not stop the stream. The private snapshot cleanup helper ignores native
   --  release status; explicit lease Close is the reporting path for release failures.
   --  @param Object Image stream from which to dequeue; Start admits image callbacks.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls without waiting.
   --  @return Complete independently owned frame and row-major payload bytes.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error No frame became available within the wait.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Stream has logically stopped with no frame available.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native/provider failure, closed stream, or invalid converted
   --  metadata/span.
   function System_Time_NS (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Long_Integer;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Integration_Time_NS
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Image system time in nanoseconds: start of integration for staring imagery, first-line time
   --  for scanning imagery. No clock or epoch is imposed.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Image system time in nanoseconds: start of integration for staring imagery,
   --  first-line time for scanning imagery. No clock or epoch is imposed.
   function Integration_Time_NS (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Long_Integer;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Width
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider integration duration in nanoseconds.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Provider integration duration in nanoseconds.
   function Width (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Height
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Image width in pixels.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Image width in pixels.
   function Height (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Bits_Per_Pixel
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Image height in pixels.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Image height in pixels.
   function Bits_Per_Pixel (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Number_Of_Bands
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Number of bits per pixel; currently accepted frames have eight.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Number of bits per pixel; currently accepted frames have eight.
   function Number_Of_Bands (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Horizontal_FOV_Rad
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Raw FrameHeader number-of-bands value; current accepted frames require one. The upstream
   --  field prose also calls this a spectral-band indicator; no decoding is performed.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Raw FrameHeader number-of-bands value; current accepted frames require one. The
   --  upstream field prose also calls this a spectral-band indicator; no decoding is performed.
   function Horizontal_FOV_Rad (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Vertical_FOV_Rad
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Horizontal field of view in radians.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Horizontal field of view in radians.
   function Vertical_FOV_Rad (Value : Full_Frame) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Contributing_Sensor_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Vertical field of view in radians.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Vertical field of view in radians.
   function Contributing_Sensor_Value (Value : Full_Frame) return Contributing_Sensor;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Pixel_Format
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Copied contributing-sensor identity and location.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Copied contributing-sensor identity and location.
   function Pixel_Format (Value : Full_Frame) return AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.Pixel_Format;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Frame_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider pixel format; the current receive path accepts Mono only and performs no decoding
   --  or conversion.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Provider pixel format; the current receive path accepts Mono only and performs no
   --  decoding or conversion.
   function Frame_ID (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Subframe_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider frame identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Provider frame identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   function Subframe_ID (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Subframe_Total
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider subframe identifier, without bridge renumbering.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Provider subframe identifier, without bridge renumbering.
   function Subframe_Total (Value : Full_Frame) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Image_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Provider total number of subframes in a frame.
   --  @param Value Ada-owned frame snapshot to inspect.
   --  @return Provider total number of subframes in a frame.
   function Image_Type (Value : Full_Frame) return Full_Image_Type;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Image_Flip
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Acquire_Frame
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Limited owner of one native snapshot retaining a provider-owned registered host buffer. The
   --  Frame Lease borrowed path performs no bulk image-payload copy from the MEL provider's
   --  registered host buffer into Ada. This is not end-to-end sensor zero-copy: pinned Squall
   --  copies UDP bytes into that host buffer; no DMA or kernel/network-stack zero-copy is claimed.
   --  Small metadata is copied at acquisition. A held lease keeps a provider buffer checked out;
   --  slow consumers cause backpressure or possible provider drops. Public stream/Session closure
   --  can be logical while physical teardown remains deferred behind leases, requests and release
   --  obligations. Closing the final child can trigger retained cleanup. Finalization is
   --  non-raising and can deliberately retain resources after uncertain release. Do not race
   --  lifecycle operations on a shared Ada object. Independent already-acquired leases may be
   --  processed separately; the stream still supports only one receive/acquire consumer.

     (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Frame_Lease;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Dequeues and owns one native snapshot, copying only small metadata and retaining the
   --  provider payload by address and length. Uses the same Mono8 single-band validated queue as
   --  owned Receive. At most one receive/acquire consumer may operate on a stream at once;
   --  independent acquired leases can be processed separately. Stream Stop/Close stops admission
   --  and can defer physical cleanup without invalidating held leases. Provider callbacks and
   --  navigation completion are synchronized internally, not permission for arbitrary concurrent
   --  operations on one Ada owner.
   --  @param Object Image stream to consume; Start admits image callbacks.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Queue wait in milliseconds; zero is a nonblocking poll.
   --  @return Limited owner of one checked-out provider buffer and copied metadata.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error No frame is available within the wait; does not stop the stream.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Stream is logically stopped and no frame is available.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed stream, invalid converted metadata or payload span,
   --  or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Tests only whether this lease holds a native snapshot handle; does not query provider
   --  health.

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Pixel_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Closes the lease and invalidates its borrowed payload, also on provider-release failure. An
   --  already-closed lease is a no-op. The retained buffer is returned through the published
   --  Buffer release operation when successful. Provider failure or exception makes ownership
   --  uncertain: the bridge deliberately retains the provider graph, exact buffer object and host
   --  memory to avoid unsafe reuse or unload. This is not successful buffer release; the failed
   --  release is not automatically retried. Explicit Close reports failure, whereas automatic
   --  finalization suppresses it and can retain resources for safety. Final-child closure may
   --  perform deferred channel cleanup. Do not race Close with a borrow, copy, or another
   --  operation on this same lease.
   --  @param Frame Lease consumed by this operation; its payload count becomes zero.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native buffer release or deferred cleanup did not complete safely.

   function Pixel_Count (Frame : Frame_Lease) return Natural;

   --  count. Explicit Close resets it to zero.

   --  @return Validated byte count captured at acquisition, or zero after explicit Close.

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Copy_Pixels
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Synchronously invokes Process with a read-only-by-contract array aliasing native/provider
   --  storage, without a bulk payload copy. Array bounds are one through the byte count (one
   --  through zero if empty). The borrow ends when Process returns or raises: do not retain an
   --  address, slice, view or access object beyond that invocation. Keep the owning lease open
   --  throughout processing and do not race its Close. An exception from Process propagates
   --  without consuming the lease. Requires an open lease; enabled precondition checking raises
   --  Assertion Error on violation, while the body separately raises Provider Error for a closed
   --  handle or invalid payload address. No general thread safety or callback-quiescence guarantee
   --  is implied.
   --  @param Frame Open owning lease which must remain open throughout Process.
   --  @param Process Synchronous read-only processor; must not retain any reference to borrowed
   --  storage.

   with Pre => Is_Open (Frame);

      Longitude_Rad                : Long_Float;
      Altitude_M                   : Long_Float;
      Attitude                     : AMS.MEL.Status.Euler;
      Attitude_Rate                : Image.Attitude_Rate;
      Speed                        : North_East_Down;
      Acceleration                 : North_East_Down;
      Wander_Angle_Rad             : Long_Float;
      Magnetic_Heading             : Long_Float;
      Altitude_MSL                 : Long_Float;
      Position_Velocity_Covariance : Image.Position_Velocity_Covariance;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Navigation_Response
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Complete supplied Common MEL navigation report. Submission transmits these values; it does
   --  not estimate, normalize or transform kinematics. Angle, altitude and velocity units below
   --  follow the pinned header only.
   --  @field System_Time_NS System time for the report in nanoseconds; no clock or epoch is
   --  specified.
   --  @field State Reported aircraft position-solution state.
   --  @field Latitude_Rad Latitude in radians.
   --  @field Longitude_Rad Longitude in radians.
   --  @field Altitude_M Altitude in meters; no additional datum is imposed by the bridge.
   --  @field Attitude Euler attitude; see the canonical Status Euler definition.
   --  @field Attitude_Rate Euler attitude rate and its separate timestamp; rate units are not
   --  explicitly specified upstream.
   --  @field Speed North/East/Down speed in meters per second.
   --  @field Acceleration North/East/Down acceleration in meters per second squared.
   --  @field Wander_Angle_Rad Wander angle in radians.
   --  @field Magnetic_Heading Provider magnetic heading; the pinned declaration specifies no unit.
   --  @field Altitude_MSL Upstream altitudeMSL value, described as barometric altitude; no
   --  explicit unit is stated for this field.
   --  @field Position_Velocity_Covariance All 18 provided covariance values; the bridge does not
   --  estimate them.

   type Navigation_Response is record
      System_Time_NS : Long_Long_Integer;
      Command_ID     : Interfaces.Unsigned_32;
      Request_ID     : Interfaces.Unsigned_32;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Navigation_Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Owned copy of the upstream navigation acknowledgement, shared by request results and the
   --  metadata response subtype.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Provider response system time in nanoseconds; no clock or epoch is
   --  specified.
   --  @field Command_ID Provider command identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   --  @field Request_ID Provider request identifier, preserving all 32 bits; no identity is
   --  generated by this accessor.

   type Navigation_Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Navigation_Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Terminal provider response category, distinct from transport/provider exceptions.
   --  @enum Success Provider completed with a nonnull navigation response.
   --  @enum Rejected Provider completed with an explicit MEL error; inspect rejection code and
   --  description.
   type Navigation_Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Navigation_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Explicit Common MEL rejection reason. The bridge maps known enumerators, not a numeric
   --  severity scale; unknown provider codes fail closed.
   --  @enum None No specific error reason supplied.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Provider reports an invalid identifier.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Provider reports an invalid state.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Provider reports invalid parameters.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Provider reports insufficient permissions.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Provider reports insufficient resources without a local/remote
   --  distinction.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Provider reports insufficient local resources.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Provider reports insufficient remote resources.
   --  @enum Unsupported Provider reports the request is unsupported.
   type Navigation_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Status
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Ada-owned terminal navigation response or explicit rejection. Provider exceptions, null
   --  successful responses, unknown error codes and native failures raise Provider Error rather
   --  than becoming Rejected. Values survive request closure.
   function Status (Result : Navigation_Result) return Navigation_Outcome;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Response
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Returns the terminal response category stored in this result.
   --  @param Result Owned terminal navigation result.
   --  @return Success or explicit provider rejection.
   function Response (Result : Navigation_Result) return Navigation_Response
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Reads the successful response from an owned result. Requires Status equal to Success;
   --  enabled precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does not
   --  add an outcome check.
   --  @param Result Terminal result with the required outcome.
   --  @return Copied navigation response.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Navigation_Result) return Navigation_Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Reads the rejection detail from an owned result. Requires Status equal to Rejected; enabled
   --  precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does not add an
   --  outcome check.
   --  @param Result Terminal result with the required outcome.
   --  @return Mapped provider rejection reason.
   function Description (Result : Navigation_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Navigation_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Reads the rejection detail from an owned result. Requires Status equal to Rejected; enabled
   --  precondition checks raise Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does not add an
   --  outcome check.
   --  @param Result Terminal result with the required outcome.
   --  @return Independent Ada string containing the full rejection description.

   type Navigation_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Submit_Navigation_Report
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Limited owner of a public asynchronous navigation request handle. A private completion
   --  worker consumes the provider future once and caches its terminal result. Pending work
   --  retains the underlying stream, Session and provider code after public Close. A future that
   --  never completes can retain those resources indefinitely. Finalization closes the public
   --  handle without raising; neither it nor explicit Close cancels provider work.
   function Submit_Navigation_Report
     (Object : AMS.MEL.IR.Image_Stream; Report : Navigation_Report) return Navigation_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Submits the supplied report while the stream is logically Attached or Running; Start is not
   --  required. Synchronously copies the report into the provider representation and returns a
   --  request, not proof of completion or acceptance. Provider send executes outside the frame
   --  callback lock so synchronous metadata callbacks can proceed. Application operations on the
   --  same stream owner require external serialization. Pending navigation requests and image
   --  leases independently delay physical cleanup after logical Stop/Close; corrected native
   --  teardown synchronization adopts actual cleanup outcomes.
   --  @param Object Attached or running image stream to which the report is sent.
   --  @param Report Provided navigation solution and all detailed kinematics; no solution is
   --  computed here.
   --  @return Open limited request handle; use Wait for the terminal response.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Invalid stream lifecycle, provider send failure or native
   --  submission failure.
   --  @exception Resource_Exhausted Shared asynchronous-request admission limit reached.
   function Is_Open (Request : Navigation_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Tests local navigation request handle ownership, not future readiness.
   --  @param Request Request owner to inspect.
   --  @return True while this public request handle is nonnull.
   function Wait
     (Request : Navigation_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Navigation_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Image.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Image.signature:
--  Waits for a cached terminal result without consuming the request. Timeout is not
   --  cancellation; later waits may obtain completion and repeated terminal waits return the
   --  cached result. Requires an open request in practice; closed handles and provider/native
   --  failures raise Provider Error. Public request Close must not race Wait. Cleanup failure
   --  after provider completion is reported as a failure rather than a false successful response.
   --  Rejection text is copied completely using a checked second cached read when needed; invalid
   --  UTF-8 or embedded NUL receives a native fallback description.
   --  @param Request Open navigation request to observe.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned successful response or explicit provider rejection.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error Request has not completed within the wait; remains open and
   --  pending.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed request, provider exception, invalid result, or
   --  native/deferred-cleanup failure.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Navigation_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Metadata_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Bounded owned polling of instrumentation report callbacks. Native callbacks validate and
   --  copy the four-field report into a drop-incoming queue without calling Ada. Receive returns
   --  independent Ada values. Upstream has no callback unregister operation; public consumption
   --  closure is distinct from physical provider-channel destruction.

   type Metadata_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Limited public metadata-consumption owner. Callback state belongs to the typed
   --  instrumentation channel, not this owner; finalization attempts non-raising consumption
   --  closure. Serialize operations on the same Ada object.
   function Open
     (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Queue_Capacity : Positive := 16) return Metadata_Channel;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Registers the conditionally required report callback once per attached or enabled channel,
   --  including failed attempts. Provider registration can invoke the callback synchronously. A
   --  failed registration publishes no metadata owner but retains inactive callback state as
   --  required for safety; upstream provides no unregister operation. Queue ordering follows
   --  successful enqueue, not timestamps or concurrent callback entry order.
   --  @param Channel Attached or enabled typed instrumentation owner.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Maximum queued reports; defaults to sixteen.
   --  @return Limited public polling owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/ineligible channel, repeated registration, provider
   --  registration failure/exception or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Tests local metadata handle ownership, not callback activity or channel enablement.
   --  @param Stream Public metadata owner to inspect.
   --  @return True when its local native handle is nonnull.

   function Receive
     (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Instrumentation_Report;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Metadata_Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Dequeues a complete native copied report, copies it into an Ada-owned record and closes the
   --  native temporary before return. No provider pointer escapes. Queued reports can drain after
   --  logical typed-channel closure or callback failure; an empty inactive queue raises Stream
   --  Stopped, and an empty failed queue raises Provider Error.
   --  @param Stream Open polling owner; serialize Receive and Close on this object.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum queue wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Independent report surviving metadata, channel and Session closure.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error Active queue remained empty until the wait expired.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped Inactive or stopped queue is empty.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed polling owner, failed callback state, invalid priority or
   --  native failure.

   type Metadata_Counters is record
      Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Saturating native callback counters, not counts of successful Ada receives.
   --  @field Events_Received Observed callback entries, including entries after consumption
   --  becomes inactive.
   --  @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming reports dropped when the bounded queue is
   --  full; queued reports are not evicted.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null reports or unknown priority values rejected by callback
   --  validation; copying/allocation exceptions instead fail the metadata stream.
   function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.Metadata.signature:
--  Copies current callback counters without consuming reports.
   --  @param Stream Open public polling owner.
   --  @return Independent snapshot of saturating counters.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed owner or native counter query failure.
   procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Instrumentation_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Conditionally required IR MEL instrumentation support (upstream RequiredIfInstrumentation):
   --  typed attachment, recording-level commands and owned completion reports. The metadata child
   --  polls copied reports. Inherited common channel services are accessed through common Channel
   --  support. Only the published Normal and Debug recording levels are bound.

   type Instrumentation_Config is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Create_Config
Instrumentation_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Builds a complete typed instrumentation attachment configuration without enabling or
   --  registering callbacks.
   --  @param Channel_ID Channel identity supplied to the provider.
   --  @param Platform_ID Platform identity supplied to the provider.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Component location with meter offsets and location identity strings.
   --  @return Independent configuration retaining all supplied values.

   type Instrumentation_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Limited typed owner, initially closed. Open attaches without enabling. Native child state
   --  retains Session/provider lifetime after public Session closure. A common weak view does not
   --  keep this owner alive. Finalization attempts non-raising cleanup and can retain resources
   --  when detach ownership is uncertain. Externally serialize operations on a shared Ada owner.
   function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Instrumentation_Config) return Instrumentation_Channel;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Attaches and verifies an InstrumentationChannel and its advertised instrumentation
   --  capability; no owner escapes on failure. This interface is conditionally required only for
   --  providers supporting instrumentation. Capabilities, common services and metadata
   --  registration are available while attached; instrumentation Submit requires explicit Enable.
   --  Native configuration text must be UTF-8 without embedded NUL. Failure cleanup retains the
   --  native graph if detach is uncertain.
   --  @param Parent Open IR Session supplying the child provider channel.
   --  @param Config Complete typed attachment configuration.
   --  @return Attached, not yet enabled, limited channel owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed Session, invalid text, provider attach/type/capability
   --  failure or native failure.
   function Is_Open (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Enable
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Tests local native handle ownership, not readiness, enablement or provider health.
   --  @param Channel Typed channel owner to inspect.
   --  @return True when the local typed-channel handle is nonnull.
   procedure Enable (Channel : in out Instrumentation_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Capabilities
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Explicitly enables the provider channel; repeated successful Enable is a no-op. Failure
   --  marks native lifecycle failed rather than permitting instrumentation submission.
   --  @param Channel Attached owner to enable, or already enabled owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed channel, provider rejection/exception or native
   --  failure.
   function Capabilities (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel) return IR.Channel.Channel_Capability;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: As_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Copies common capability data while the channel is attached or enabled. Returned text and
   --  collections have independent Ada ownership.
   --  @param Channel Attached or enabled instrumentation channel.
   --  @return Owned common channel capability snapshot.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Invalid lifecycle or provider/native query or conversion failure.
   function As_Channel (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel) return IR.Channel.View;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Creates a weak common Channel view while attached or enabled. Inherited KeepAlive, CommsTest
   --  and capabilities are accessed through common Channel support, not duplicated instrumentation
   --  methods. The view does not keep the typed owner alive, and closing the view does not close
   --  it.
   --  @param Channel Attached or enabled typed owner.
   --  @return New weak common channel view.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed owner or native view creation failure.
   procedure Close (Channel : in out Instrumentation_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Priority
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Idempotently closes the typed public owner and deactivates metadata consumption. Pending
   --  requests defer physical disable/detach until completion. Cleanup disables if enable was
   --  attempted, detaches and destroys the provider channel before draining bridge callbacks.
   --  Synchronous detach failure retains the owner for retry; uncertain orphaned cleanup retains
   --  the provider graph. Automatic finalization attempts non-raising cleanup, not guaranteed
   --  immediate unload.
   --  @param Channel Typed owner to close; serialize against other uses.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Disable/detach or native cleanup failure; handle may remain for
   --  retry.

   type Priority is (Normal, Debug);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Instrumentation_Level_Command
Instrumentation_Report
Instrumentation_Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Canonical owned report used both for asynchronous command completion and metadata callbacks.
   --  The pinned declaration contains only these four fields, not a variable instrumentation-data
   --  payload.
   --  @field Command_ID Provider report command identifier, preserving all 32 bits.
   --  @field Size Raw provider size field; the pinned header does not specify its units or
   --  relation to any payload length.
   --  @field Timestamp_NS Provider timestamp in nanoseconds; clock and epoch are unspecified.
   --  @field Priority Provider-reported Normal or Debug instrumentation level; unknown values fail
   --  conversion.

   type Instrumentation_Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Instrumentation_Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Terminal provider completion category, distinct from exceptions and native failures.
   --  @enum Success Provider returned a valid nonnull instrumentation report.
   --  @enum Rejected Provider completed with an explicit MEL error instead of a report.
   type Instrumentation_Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Instrumentation_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Known Common MEL rejection reasons mapped individually; not a numeric severity scale.
   --  Unknown provider codes are failures, not invented rejection categories.
   --  @enum None No specific reason supplied.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Provider reports an invalid identifier.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Provider reports an invalid state.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Provider reports invalid parameters.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Provider reports insufficient permissions.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Provider reports insufficient resources without a local/remote
   --  distinction.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Provider reports insufficient local resources.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Provider reports insufficient remote resources.
   --  @enum Unsupported Provider reports the request is unsupported.
   type Instrumentation_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Status
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Ada-owned terminal report or explicit rejection. Provider exceptions, null successful
   --  results, unknown priority/error values and native failures raise Provider Error rather than
   --  becoming a normal Rejected result. Values survive request closure.
   function Status (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Outcome;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Report
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Returns the terminal outcome stored in the result.
   --  @param Result Owned terminal instrumentation result.
   --  @return Success or explicit provider rejection.
   function Report (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Report
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Accesses the report of a terminal result. Requires Status equal to Success; enabled
   --  precondition checking raises Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does not add an
   --  outcome check.
   --  @param Result Owned terminal result satisfying the declared outcome precondition.
   --  @return Independent four-field instrumentation report.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return Instrumentation_Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Accesses the rejection detail of a terminal result. Requires Status equal to Rejected;
   --  enabled precondition checking raises Assertion Error on violation. The accessor body does
   --  not add an outcome check.
   --  @param Result Owned terminal result satisfying the declared outcome precondition.
   --  @return Mapped provider rejection reason.
   function Description (Result : Instrumentation_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Instrumentation_Request
Submit
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Limited public asynchronous-request owner. A private completion worker consumes the provider
   --  future once and caches the result while retaining the native channel, Session and provider
   --  code. Public request Close and finalization do not cancel provider work; a never-completing
   --  future can retain resources indefinitely. Finalization is non-raising.
   function Submit
     (Channel : Instrumentation_Channel; Command : Instrumentation_Level_Command)

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Submits the supplied command only while the typed channel is enabled; does not implicitly
   --  Enable. Copies command values synchronously and returns a request handle, not proof of
   --  acceptance or completion. The native provider send runs outside the lifecycle lock so
   --  synchronous metadata callbacks can proceed. A pending request retains provider resources
   --  independently after public channel and Session closure.

   function Is_Open (Request : Instrumentation_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Tests public request handle ownership, not future readiness.
   --  @param Request Request owner to inspect.
   --  @return True while the local native request handle is nonnull.
   function Wait
     (Request : Instrumentation_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural)
      return Instrumentation_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Instrumentation.signature:
--  Waits for a terminal result without consuming the request. Timeout is not cancellation;
   --  later Wait may complete, and repeated terminal waits return the identical cached result.
   --  Explicit provider rejection is returned separately from provider exceptions or native
   --  failures. Rejection text is recovered completely by a checked cached retry if necessary;
   --  invalid UTF-8/NUL text receives a native fallback. Close must not race Wait on the same
   --  request.

   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned report or explicit rejection.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error Future has not completed within the wait; request remains open.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed request, provider exception, invalid terminal result, or
   --  native/deferred-cleanup failure.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Instrumentation_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Metadata_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Four inbound callback families, not outbound RequestFor sends. Required
   --  Track reports, advertised candidate messages and two optional callbacks
   --  share one bounded drop-incoming FIFO ordered by successful enqueue, not

   --  is mock-qualified; pinned Squall cannot attach this Track channel.

   type Metadata_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Open
Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Register once while Attached or Enabled, without the Track lifecycle lock
   --  held across provider registration. Order: required Track report; candidate
   --  message only if advertised at Track Open; optional system-data request;
   --  optional candidate PreProc. Required report refusal and advertised candidate
   --  refusal fail, including NotSupported. Optional callbacks accept NotSupported
   --  non-fatally but other non-Success answers fail. Partial failure consumes
   --  the attempt and retains inactive/failed callback state without unregister;
   --  no public consumer escapes. Reopening after Close does not retry registration.
   --  @param Channel Open Attached/Enabled Track owner; serialize owner operations.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Positive shared queue bound, default sixteen events.
   --  @return Owned queue consumer; registration failure raises a provider error.

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Request_System_Track_Data
Row_Column
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:

   --  or an asynchronous request owner. No response is sent automatically.

   --  @field Command_ID Provider command correlation identifier, all 32 bits preserved.

   end record;

   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Uncertainty
Sensor_Inertial_State
Hot_Region_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned sensor navigation snapshot. Quaternions and vectors are copied, not
   --  normalized, transformed or estimated by this bridge.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Signed system-time nanosecond count; epoch unspecified.
   --  @field Q_XYZW Quaternion from sensor to local north/east/down frame, XYZW order.
   --  @field Q_ECEF_XYZW Quaternion from local north/east/down to ECEF, XYZW order.
   --  @field Sensor_Position Sensor position in ECEF, meters.
   --  @field Sensor_Velocity Sensor velocity in ECEF, meters per second.
   --  @field Uncertainties Opaque sensor/platform navigation uncertainty values.

   --  Upstream HotRegionTypeEnum. It declares no MaxExclusive value, so any
   --  provider representation outside this range is malformed and is rejected
   --  natively before it can ever reach Ada.
   type Hot_Region_Type is (Invalid, Flare, Solar, Mask);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Hot_Region
Candidate_Object_Header
Candidate_Object
Candidate_Object_Message
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Complete owned candidate detection, without numeric normalization.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Time of validity in signed nanoseconds, without an established epoch.
   --  @field Detection_Category Bitfield identifying waveband temporal depth; copied without invented bit definitions.
   --  @field Sensor_Index Unsigned index indicating sensor position, not an Ada vector index.
   --  @field Subpixel Subpixel column/row location, with no inferred pixel origin.
   --  @field Intensity Merged candidate intensity; units/calibration unspecified.
