   --  @field Sensor_Relative_Unit Detection line-of-sight unit-vector report in sensor-relative xyz; not renormalized.
   --  @field Signal_To_Interference_Ratio SIR scalar; no linear-versus-dB convention established.
   --  @field Signal_To_Noise_Ratio SNR scalar; no scale conversion or normalization performed.

   --  Wholly Ada-owned CandidateObjectMessage. The variable-size hot-region
   --  and candidate collections are copied out of the native event before that
   --  event is closed, so no native pointer, native span, or provider storage
   --  is ever exposed.
   --
   --  Exactly numberOfCOs candidate objects are present: the upstream fixed
   --  900-entry array is exposed only through its meaningful prefix.
   type Candidate_Object_Message is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Header
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned header, navigation, hot regions and candidate prefix. Upstream fixed
   --  capacity is 900; declared count greater than capacity is malformed. Only
   --  the meaningful prefix is copied, in native order, retaining duplicates.
   function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Inertial_State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy the fixed candidate-message header.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @return Owned header whose count matches the copied meaningful prefix.
   function Inertial_State (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Hot_Region_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy the message-level navigation snapshot, not a borrowed provider object.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @return Independent sensor inertial state.
   function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Hot_Region_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Count the complete copied hot-region vector in provider order.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @return Number of hot regions, independent of candidate count.
   function Hot_Region_At (Message : Candidate_Object_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Candidate_Object_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy one region; index beyond length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based copied-region position, not a pixel coordinate.
   --  @return Independent hot-region value.
   function Candidate_Object_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_Message) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Candidate_Object_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Count the copied meaningful prefix, not the fixed capacity of 900.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @return Actual copied candidate count established by the header.
   function Candidate_Object_At
     (Message : Candidate_Object_Message; Index : Positive) return Candidate_Object;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Background_Index
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy one candidate; index beyond copied prefix raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Message Owned fixed-array candidate message to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based candidate position, not the upstream sensor index.
   --  @return Independent complete candidate detection.

   --  Upstream candidateObjectWithBackground is exactly a 3 by 3 patch of
   --  int16_t intensities around the candidate object. This is an owned Ada
   --  2-D value; the flat row-major C array is mapped to it explicitly.
   subtype Background_Index is Positive range 1 .. 3;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Candidate_Background
Candidate_Object_PreProc
Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Complete owned preprocessed detection. No statistical estimation,
   --  confidence calibration, vector normalization or score clamping is done.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Time of validity in signed nanoseconds; epoch unspecified.
   --  @field Detection_Category Opaque waveband temporal-depth bitfield, all 32 bits preserved.
   --  @field Sensor_Index Unsigned sensor-position index, not an Ada vector position.
   --  @field Subpixel Subpixel column/row location with no invented pixel origin.
   --  @field Intensity Merged candidate intensity with unspecified physical units.
   --  @field Sensor_Relative_Unit Sensor-relative line-of-sight xyz unit-vector report, not renormalized.
   --  @field Signal_To_Interference_Ratio SIR scalar without an established dB/linear convention.
   --  @field Signal_To_Noise_Ratio SNR scalar without scale conversion.
   --  @field Candidate_Object_With_Background Exact signed 16-bit 3x3 intensity patch around this candidate.
   --  @field Clutter Provider clutter scalar, with no established numeric range.
   --  @field Candidate_Object_Quality Upstream documents zero to one, but setters/bridge do not enforce or clamp it.
   --  @field Sir_Delta Signal intensity from threshold, reporting candidate sensitivity; units unspecified.
   --  @field Inertial_State This entry's own navigation snapshot, distinct from the message-level state.
   --  @field Edge True when detection is near an obscuration, as reported by the provider.
   --  @field Az_Sigma Azimuth-measurement uncertainty scalar; unit/confidence convention unspecified.
   --  @field El_Sigma Elevation-measurement uncertainty scalar; unit/confidence convention unspecified.
   --  @field Background_Normalizer Background-noise statistic used for SIR, without bridge calculation.

   --  Wholly Ada-owned CandidateObjectPreProcMessage. The variable-size
   --  hot-region and PreProc collections are copied out of the native event
   --  before that event is closed, so no native pointer, native span, or
   --  provider storage is ever exposed.
   --
   --  Unlike Candidate_Object_Message, the upstream container here is a
   --  std::vector that already carries its own size, and the pinned headers
   --  publish NO invariant requiring Number_Of_COs to equal that size. Both
   --  values are therefore preserved verbatim: Header reports the provider's
   --  Number_Of_COs and Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count reports the actual
   --  vector length. A mismatch is not an error here.
   type Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Header
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Owned header/navigation/hot regions and independently sized PreProc vector.
   --  Header count need not equal vector length; both values survive unchanged.
   --  Native vector order and duplicates are preserved, without a 900-entry cap.
   function Header (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Candidate_Object_Header;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Inertial_State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy the provider header without replacing its reported candidate count.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @return Header whose declared count is independent of actual vector length.
   function Inertial_State
     (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Sensor_Inertial_State;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Hot_Region_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy message-level navigation, distinct from per-entry inertial snapshots.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @return Independent message-level sensor inertial state.
   function Hot_Region_Count (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Hot_Region_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Count the complete copied hot-region vector in provider order.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @return Hot-region count, independent of candidate/header counts.
   function Hot_Region_At
     (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Hot_Region;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a region; index beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based hot-region position, not a pixel coordinate.
   --  @return Independent hot-region value.
   function Candidate_Object_PreProc_Count
     (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Candidate_Object_PreProc_At
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Count the actual copied PreProc vector, not the header's candidate count.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @return Actual vector length, even when header count differs.
   function Candidate_Object_PreProc_At
     (Message : Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message; Index : Positive) return Candidate_Object_PreProc;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Metadata_Kind
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Copy a PreProc entry; index beyond vector length raises a constraint error.
   --  @param Message Owned PreProc message to inspect.
   --  @param Index One-based vector position in provider order.
   --  @return Independent preprocessed detection including its patch and navigation.

   --  The implemented Track metadata event kinds. Receive_Event fails closed on
   --  any other native kind.
   type Metadata_Kind is
     (IRST_Track_Report_Event,
      Request_System_Track_Data_Event,
      Candidate_Object_Message_Event,
      Candidate_Object_PreProc_Message_Event);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Metadata_Event
Receive_Event
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Discriminated wholly owned event; selecting an inactive variant component
   --  is governed by Ada discriminant checks, not a provider pointer lifetime.
   --  @field Kind Active inbound callback alternative.
   --  @field Report Complete owned IRST report for the report alternative.
   --  @field Request Owned inbound system-data request, not an outbound request handle.
   --  @field Candidates Owned fixed-array candidate prefix and associated metadata.
   --  @field Candidate_PreProcs Owned independently sized PreProc vector and associated metadata.

   --  Receives the next event of either kind. A positive timeout blocks until
   --  an event arrives, the stream stops, or the timeout expires; a zero
   --  timeout is a nonblocking poll. No Ada thread spins: the native adapter
   --  waits on a condition variable.
   --  Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR.
   function Receive_Event
     (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Metadata_Event;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Pop the oldest successfully enqueued event of any supported kind. Queued
   --  values drain before stopped/failed state is reported. Empty active timeout
   --  raises the inherited timeout exception; stopped/inactive raises the
   --  inherited stopped-stream exception; native/callback/conversion failure
   --  raises a provider error. Native storage is released on copying exceptions.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata consumer, externally serialized against Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls.
   --  @return Wholly Ada-owned discriminated event with no surviving provider references.

   --  Report-only convenience retained for existing callers. It raises
   --  Provider_Error if the next event is any non-report Track metadata kind,
   --  so an application that can receive more than one kind should use
   --  Receive_Event. Timeout_Error is inherited from AMS.MEL.IR.
   function Receive
     (Stream : Metadata_Channel; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return IRST_Track_Report;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Metadata_Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Report-only convenience that consumes the next event. A non-report event
   --  raises a provider error after consumption; it is not skipped or requeued.
   --  Use the general event receiver for mixed kinds. Timeout/stopped/native
   --  failure behavior is the same as that receiver.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata consumer, externally serialized against Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; default zero polls.
   --  @return Owned report only when the consumed event has report kind.

   type Metadata_Counters is record
      Events_Received, Events_Dropped_Queue_Full, Malformed_Or_Unsupported : Counter;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Shared unsigned counters saturate without wrapping. Callback receipt is
   --  counted before checking active consumption; totals need not sum to received.
   --  @field Events_Received Observed callback entries for all four supported families.
   --  @field Events_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming events discarded when the shared queue is full.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Null/malformed/unsupported payload drops; callback exceptions instead fail the stream.
   function Counters (Stream : Metadata_Channel) return Metadata_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Metadata.signature:
--  Read synchronized queue counters; closed handle/native failure raises a
   --  provider error. Query does not reset counts or poll provider metadata.
   --  @param Stream Open metadata consumer.
   --  @return Owned saturating counts observed at query time.
   procedure Close (Stream : in out Metadata_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Azimuth_Elevation
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Optional outbound system Track data response, distinct from inbound
   --  system-data-request metadata. Requires Enabled Track; no automatic response
   --  or physical incorporation guarantee is supplied. Positive qualification is
   --  mock-only; pinned Squall cannot attach the Track channel. Request lifetime
   --  and admission are shared natively with updates and common Channel requests.

   --  The one canonical Track-facing azimuth/elevation value. Both components
   --  are radians and neither is clamped or normalized.
   type Azimuth_Elevation is record
      Azimuth_Rad   : Long_Float;
      Elevation_Rad : Long_Float;
   end record;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: System_Track_Data_Response
Command_State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Complete outbound payload. Validity flags are provider data, not bridge
   --  commands to zero inactive fields. All values are copied through native
   --  double/scalar fields without physical consistency checks or normalization.
   --  @field System_Time_NS Signed system-time nanosecond count; epoch unspecified.
   --  @field Command_ID Unsigned command correlation identifier, all 32 bits retained.
   --  @field Request_ID Unsigned system-data request correlation identifier.
   --  @field Track_ID Unsigned numeric track identifier, not a UCI identity.
   --  @field Range_M Range in meters, copied even if range validity is false.
   --  @field Range_Rate_MPS Range rate in meters per second, without sign normalization.
   --  @field Range_Error_M Range error in meters, without clamping.
   --  @field Range_Rate_Error_MPS Range-rate error in meters per second.
   --  @field Az_El_Valid Provider angular-validity flag; false does not zero either angular pair.
   --  @field Inertial_Az_El Inertial azimuth/elevation in radians, copied without transformation.
   --  @field Az_El_Error Angular errors in radians; no statistical confidence convention inferred.
   --  @field Range_Valid Provider range-validity flag; false does not remove or zero range fields.

   --  Upstream CommandState, with the published numeric representations
   --  already used by the C ABI. This package deliberately does not depend on
   --  AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata merely to reuse its enums; a cross-package
   --  neutralization refactor is out of scope here. Every representation is
   --  pinned explicitly rather than left to declaration order.
   type Command_State is (Not_Set, Received, Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Cannot_Comply
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Upstream CannotComply, with the published numeric representations.
   --  Every literal is pinned explicitly rather than left to declaration
   --  order, so the mapping matches AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata exactly.
   type Cannot_Comply is
     (Not_Set,
      Constraint_Attempts,
      Constraint_Endurance,
      Constraint_Classification,
      Constraint_For_FOV_Limit,
      Constraint_Gating,
      Constraint_Maneuver_Limit,
      Constraint_Op,
      Constraint_Occlusion,
      Capability_Range,
      Capability_Performance,
      Constraint_RF,
      Constraint_Route,
      Constraint_Safety,
      Constraint_Target_Angle,
      Constraint_Time,
      Constraint_System,
      Infeasible_Route,
      Mission_Event,
      State_Or_Settings,
      State_Or_Settings_Change,
      System_Unavailable,
      System_Fault,
      System_Conflict,
      Subsystem_Unavailable,
      Subsystem_Fault,
      Capability_Fault,
      Capability_Precedence,
      Capability_Unavailable,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Ranking,
      Weather,
      Ineligible_Control_Source,
      Dependency_Predecessor,
      Dependency_All_Or_Nothing,
      Dependency_Either_Or,
      Init_Criteria_Not_Met,
      Unknown_ID,
      Invalid_Input_Parameter,
      Input_Other,
      MDF_Activation_Error,
      Multiple,
      Cancelled,
      Other,
      Unknown,
      Aborted,
      Alignment_Maneuver);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Command_Status
Command_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Owned CommandStatus payload returned by a successful provider future.
   --  Its own rejected command state remains a Success future outcome; only an
   --  upstream ErrorOr error produces a rejected response outcome.
   function Command_ID (Status : Command_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Read the returned command correlation identifier.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported unsigned command ID, not a bridge-generated sequence.
   function State (Status : Command_Status) return Command_State;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Reason
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Read reported command messaging state, not physical completion.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Preserved command state, including Rejected within a successful future.
   function Reason (Status : Command_Status) return Cannot_Comply;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Reason_Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Read the inability category without adding bridge policy.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Source-mapped reason; the zero category denotes an unset optional reason.
   function Reason_Description (Status : Command_Status) return String;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Response_Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Copy the command-status reason, validated natively as UTF-8 without NUL.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Independent reason text copied from immutable native result storage.

   type Response_Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Response_Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Terminal future category, not submission acceptance or physical execution.
   --  @enum Success Future returned a valid CommandStatus, whose own command state can still be Rejected.
   --  @enum Rejected Future returned an explicit upstream ErrorOr error.
   type Response_Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Response_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Known upstream rejection categories mapped to native values 0..8.
   --  Session admission refusal is a separate exception, not one of these results.
   --  @enum None No-error category, value 0, preserved if present in an upstream error.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7.
   --  @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8.

   --  A successful CommandStatus whose own State is Rejected is still a
   --  Success outcome: CommandStatus rejection is not an ErrorOr rejection.
   type Response_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Status
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Owned terminal CommandStatus payload or explicit rejection. Neither
   --  successful submission nor successful future completion establishes that
   --  the provider operationally incorporated the response.
   function Status (Result : Response_Result) return Response_Outcome;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Command
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Read the stored terminal future category without provider access.
   --  @param Result Owned response result to inspect.
   --  @return Payload success or explicit ErrorOr rejection.
   function Command (Result : Response_Result) return Command_Status
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Copy the payload under the declared Success precondition. The expression
   --  body adds no independent outcome check when assertions are disabled.
   --  @param Result Successful response result.
   --  @return Owned CommandStatus; inspect its state separately from future outcome.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Response_Result) return Response_Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Description
Response_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body
   --  directly returns stored text without an independent outcome check.
   --  @param Result Explicitly rejected response result.
   --  @return Complete owned diagnostic, using consistent cached retry for long text.

   --  Submission requires an enabled Track_Channel.
   type Response_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Submit
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Limited controlled response observer, distinct from update/common owners.
   --  A pending native worker independently retains Track/Session/provider graph
   --  and Session admission permit. Observer closure is not cancellation or direct
   --  pending-permit release; finalization closes without raising.
   function Submit
     (Channel : Track_Channel; Value : System_Track_Data_Response) return Response_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Copy and submit the optional response while Track is Enabled. Native
   --  accounting precedes unlocked provider send. Attached-only/failed/closed
   --  resources and native/provider failures raise a provider error; Session-wide
   --  admission refusal raises the resource-exhaustion exception. No field is
   --  zeroed based on validity flags and no physical validation is promised.
   --  @param Channel Enabled Track owner; externally serialize its public operations.
   --  @param Value Complete response payload copied before submission returns.
   --  @return Admitted observer, not provider acceptance or operational incorporation.
   function Is_Open (Request : Response_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Inspect public observer-handle presence without polling completion.
   --  @param Request Response observer to inspect.
   --  @return True for a present handle, whether pending or terminal.
   function Wait
     (Request : Response_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Response_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.System_Data.signature:
--  Await or repeat a cached terminal result. Timeout raises the inherited
   --  timeout exception without consumption/cancellation. Explicit ErrorOr
   --  rejection returns a result; provider/native failure raises a provider error.
   --  Malformed status and deferred Track cleanup failure also raise that error;
   --  failed deferred cleanup safely retains resources instead of unloading code.
   --  @param Request Open response observer; must not race its Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned cached terminal payload or explicit rejection.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Response_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Track_Status
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Outbound TrackDataUpdate under the upstream track-update condition, which
   --  is distinct from basic Track support. Requires Enabled Track. Positive
   --  execution is mock-qualified only; pinned Squall cannot attach Track.
   --  Bridge copies kinematics/covariance, performing no estimation, coordinate
   --  transformation, normalization or operational-incorporation verification.

   --  Upstream TrackStatus, exactly Create = 0, Update = 1, Predict = 2, and
   --  Delete = 3. Upstream declares no MaxExclusive value.
   type Track_Status is (Create, Update, Predict, Delete);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Directional
Track_Covariance
Track_Data_Update
Command_State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Complete outbound update with floating epoch-second times, not nanosecond
   --  timestamps. All scalars cross as native double without clamping. UCI
   --  labels are copied after UTF-8/no-NUL validation before Submit returns.
   --  @field Platform_ID Unsigned integer platform identifier, distinct from structured UCI identities.
   --  @field Capability_UUID Structured capability UCI identity and descriptive label.
   --  @field Activity_UUID Structured activity UCI identity and descriptive label.
   --  @field Track_ID Unsigned integer track identifier, all 32 bits preserved.
   --  @field Entity_UUID Structured entity UCI identity and descriptive label.
   --  @field Status Track create/update/predict/delete category; no bridge tracker action is performed.
   --  @field Time_Of_Validity_Seconds Floating-point time of validity in epoch seconds; a more specific epoch is not established.
   --  @field Time_Of_Last_Update_Seconds Floating-point last-update time in epoch seconds, not nanoseconds.
   --  @field Position_ECEF Provider/application ECEF position components, copied without transformation.
   --  @field Velocity_ECEF Provider/application ECEF velocity components, copied without estimation or unit conversion.
   --  @field Covariance Twenty-one individually preserved Track covariance values, not Image navigation covariance.
   --  @field Maneuver_Probability Upstream probability zero-to-one: zero unlikely, one likely maneuvering; not range-enforced here.
   --  @field Track_Quality Upstream allowed quality range zero through fifteen; copied without clamping or calibration.

   --  Upstream CommandState, with the published numeric representations
   --  already used by the C ABI. This package deliberately does not depend on
   --  AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata merely to reuse its enums; a cross-package
   --  neutralization refactor is out of scope here.
   type Command_State is (Not_Set, Received, Accepted, Rejected, Cancelled);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Cannot_Comply
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Upstream CannotComply, with the published numeric representations.
   --  Every literal is pinned explicitly rather than left to declaration
   --  order, so the mapping matches AMS.MEL.IR.C2.Metadata exactly.
   type Cannot_Comply is
     (Not_Set,
      Constraint_Attempts,
      Constraint_Endurance,
      Constraint_Classification,
      Constraint_For_FOV_Limit,
      Constraint_Gating,
      Constraint_Maneuver_Limit,
      Constraint_Op,
      Constraint_Occlusion,
      Capability_Range,
      Capability_Performance,
      Constraint_RF,
      Constraint_Route,
      Constraint_Safety,
      Constraint_Target_Angle,
      Constraint_Time,
      Constraint_System,
      Infeasible_Route,
      Mission_Event,
      State_Or_Settings,
      State_Or_Settings_Change,
      System_Unavailable,
      System_Fault,
      System_Conflict,
      Subsystem_Unavailable,
      Subsystem_Fault,
      Capability_Fault,
      Capability_Precedence,
      Capability_Unavailable,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Ranking,
      Weather,
      Ineligible_Control_Source,
      Dependency_Predecessor,
      Dependency_All_Or_Nothing,
      Dependency_Either_Or,
      Init_Criteria_Not_Met,
      Unknown_ID,
      Invalid_Input_Parameter,
      Input_Other,
      MDF_Activation_Error,
      Multiple,
      Cancelled,
      Other,
      Unknown,
      Aborted,
      Alignment_Maneuver);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Command_Status
Command_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Owned CommandStatus payload from a successful future. A payload whose own
   --  command state is Rejected is still a successful future result, unlike an
   --  explicit ErrorOr rejection. No physical incorporation guarantee follows.
   function Command_ID (Status : Command_Status) return Interfaces.Unsigned_32;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Read the returned command correlation identifier.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Provider-reported unsigned command identifier.
   function State (Status : Command_Status) return Command_State;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Reason
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Read reported command messaging state, not physical execution progress.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Preserved state, including command Rejected within future Success.
   function Reason (Status : Command_Status) return Cannot_Comply;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Reason_Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Read the reported inability reason without policy interpretation.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Source-mapped reason; zero denotes an unset optional reason.
   function Reason_Description (Status : Command_Status) return String;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Update_Outcome
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Copy reason text validated natively as UTF-8 without embedded NUL.
   --  @param Status Owned command-status payload to inspect.
   --  @return Independent text copied from immutable native cached storage.

   type Update_Outcome is (Success, Rejected);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Update_Error_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Terminal future category, distinct from submission or physical acceptance.
   --  @enum Success Future produced a valid CommandStatus; its own state can still be Rejected.
   --  @enum Rejected Future produced an explicit upstream ErrorOr error.
   type Update_Error_Code is
     (None,
      Invalid_ID,
      Invalid_State,
      Invalid_Parameters,
      Insufficient_Permissions,
      Insufficient_Resources,
      Insufficient_Local_Resources,
      Insufficient_Remote_Resources,
      Unsupported);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Update_Result
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Known upstream rejection categories mapped to native values 0..8.
   --  Session admission refusal is a separate exception, not one of these results.
   --  @enum None No-error category, value 0, preserved if present in an upstream error.
   --  @enum Invalid_ID Invalid identifier category, value 1.
   --  @enum Invalid_State Invalid state category, value 2.
   --  @enum Invalid_Parameters Invalid parameters category, value 3.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Permissions Insufficient permissions category, value 4.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Resources Insufficient resources category, value 5.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Local_Resources Insufficient local resources category, value 6.
   --  @enum Insufficient_Remote_Resources Insufficient remote resources category, value 7.
   --  @enum Unsupported Unsupported request category, value 8.

   --  A successful CommandStatus whose own State is Rejected is still a
   --  Success outcome: CommandStatus rejection is not an ErrorOr rejection.
   type Update_Result is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Status
Command
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Read the stored future category without contacting the provider.
   --  @param Result Owned update result to inspect.
   --  @return Payload success or explicit upstream rejection.
   function Command (Result : Update_Result) return Command_Status
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Success;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Rejection_Code
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Copy status under the declared Success precondition; the expression body
   --  performs no independent outcome check when assertions are disabled.
   --  @param Result Successful update result.
   --  @return Owned CommandStatus; its command state is separate from future outcome.
   function Rejection_Code (Result : Update_Result) return Update_Error_Code
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Description
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Read the error category under the declared Rejected precondition; no
   --  independent body outcome check is performed.
   --  @param Result Explicitly rejected update result.
   --  @return Mapped upstream error code, not Session admission exhaustion.
   function Description (Result : Update_Result) return String
   with Pre => Status (Result) = Rejected;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Update_Request
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Copy rejection text under the declared Rejected precondition; the body
   --  simply returns its stored string without independently checking outcome.
   --  @param Result Explicitly rejected update result.
   --  @return Complete owned diagnostic, with consistent cached retry for long text.

   --  Submission requires an enabled Track_Channel.
   type Update_Request is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Submit
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Limited controlled update observer, distinct from system-response/common
   --  Ada owners. Native pending work independently retains the Track graph and
   --  Session admission permit. Finalization is non-raising; closure is not
   --  cancellation or direct release of a still-pending admission permit.
   function Submit (Channel : Track_Channel; Value : Track_Data_Update) return Update_Request;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Copy and send the update while Track is Enabled. Native lifecycle claim
   --  precedes unlocked provider send; no kinematic/score/covariance estimation
   --  or physical consistency validation is promised. Session admission refusal
   --  raises the resource-exhaustion exception; closed/ineligible channels,
   --  invalid text and other native/provider failures raise a provider error.
   --  @param Channel Enabled Track owner; externally serialize owner operations.
   --  @param Value Complete update copied before Submit returns, including identity labels.
   --  @return Admitted observer, not confirmation of provider acceptance/incorporation.
   function Is_Open (Request : Update_Request) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Wait
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Inspect observer-handle presence without querying future completion.
   --  @param Request Update observer to inspect.
   --  @return True when its native public handle is present, pending or terminal.
   function Wait (Request : Update_Request; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural) return Update_Result;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.Updates.signature:
--  Wait for a terminal result, cached for repeat waits. Timeout raises the
   --  inherited timeout exception without consuming/cancelling. Explicit ErrorOr
   --  rejection is a result; provider/native/malformed-output failure raises a
   --  provider error. Deferred Track cleanup failure also fails the result closed
   --  and safely retains the graph rather than unloading uncertain provider code.
   --  @param Request Open update observer; must not race Close.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Maximum wait in milliseconds; zero polls.
   --  @return Owned cached CommandStatus or explicit rejection.
   procedure Close (Request : in out Update_Request);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Track_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Safe Track attachment, lifecycle and complete inbound IRST report value.
   --  Positive Track behavior is mock-qualified only. Pinned Squall's Control
   --  attachment has no Track case and returns null; its real-provider evidence
   --  is an expected-negative unsupported path, not successful Track execution.
   --  Child packages separate inbound metadata from the two outbound sends.
   --  Serialize public operations and Close on a shared typed owner externally.

   type Track_Config is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Create_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Owned channel/platform UCI identities and sensor component location for
   --  an IRST Track attachment; creating a value performs no provider operation.
   function Create_Config
     (Channel_ID : UCI_ID; Platform_ID : UCI_ID; Sensor_Location : Component_Location)
      return Track_Config;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Track_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Copy identities and sensor location without attaching or enabling.
   --  @param Channel_ID Requested Track channel UCI identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Platform_ID Platform UCI identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Sensor component offsets and location identity.
   --  @return Independent owned configuration for Track Open.

   type Track_Channel is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Limited controlled owner of an attached provider Track channel, retaining
   --  the native Session graph independently of the parent Ada Session. Pending
   --  updates, system responses and common requests share native request counts
   --  and can retain resources after public closure. Finalization is non-raising.
   function Open (Parent : Session; Config : Track_Config) return Track_Channel;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Require an open Session and published Track capability, attach using the
   --  Track category and verify the concrete Track interface. Configuration text
   --  is validated natively. Failure raises a provider error; no owner escapes.
   --  Pinned Squall cannot attach this category. Positive behavior is mock-only.
   --  @param Parent Open Session whose native graph is retained by the child.
   --  @param Config Owned attachment values copied before provider use.
   --  @return Attached, not Enabled, Track owner.
   function Is_Open (Channel : Track_Channel) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Enable
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Test local handle presence, not lifecycle eligibility or provider support.
   --  @param Channel Track owner to inspect without provider access.
   --  @return True for a present native handle, even if lifecycle has failed.
   procedure Enable (Channel : in out Track_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Capabilities
As_Channel
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Copy provider capabilities while Attached or Enabled. A closed/failed
   --  lifecycle or native conversion failure raises a provider error. Querying
   --  does not enable services or register callbacks.
   --  @param Channel Eligible Track owner, externally serialized against Close.
   --  @return Owned snapshot valid after channel, Session and provider closure.
   function As_Channel (Channel : Track_Channel) return IR.Channel.View;

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Allocate a weak common view without changing lifecycle. Closed owner or
   --  native failure raises a provider error. View closure leaves this typed
   --  owner intact; admitted common requests retain their own lifetime claims.
   --  @param Channel Open Track owner to reference weakly.
   --  @return Weak common view; its handle presence does not prove target existence.
   procedure Close (Channel : in out Track_Channel);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: IRST_Track_State
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Stop public admission and close the owner without cancelling futures.
   --  Physical disable/detach waits for all pending update, system-response and
   --  common requests. Disable is attempted if enabling was attempted; detach
   --  failure retains the graph/handle for retry. Disable failure can raise a
   --  provider error even after successful detach consumed the handle. Provider
   --  channel destruction, then callback-count drain, establishes quiescence;
   --  disable return alone does not. Orphaned unsafe cleanup retains resources.
   --  @param Channel Track owner to close; serialize against its public operations.

   --  Upstream IrstTrackState. The Idle literal is prefixed because
   --  IrstTrackMode declares an Idle of its own in the same scope.
   type IRST_Track_State is (State_Idle, Detected, Coast, Dropped);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: IRST_Track_Mode
AMS.MEL.IR.Track.signature:
--  Upstream IrstTrackMode.
   type IRST_Track_Mode is (Mode_Idle, Scan, Stare);

AMS.MEL.IR.Track.name: North_East_Down
IRST_Track_Report

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Byte
UUID
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Unsigned eight-bit octet used for UUID bytes and monochrome pixel storage.

   type UUID is array (Natural range 0 .. 15) of Byte;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Pixel_Array
UCI_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Unconstrained array of octets. Legacy received Frames own a one-based
   --  array of monochrome samples; borrowed views in child APIs have separate
   --  lifetime contracts and must not be treated as owned merely by this type.

   type UCI_ID is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Create_UCI_ID
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Ada-owned UUID and descriptive label. Predefined Ada equality compares
   --  both fields, including the label; matching UUID bytes alone need not make
   --  two Ada values equal. Pinned upstream equality also compares both fields.

   function Create_UCI_ID (Value : UUID; Descriptive_Label : String) return UCI_ID;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: UUID_Value
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy binary identity and descriptive text without parsing a textual UUID.
   --  @param Value All sixteen UUID bytes, preserved in array order.
   --  @param Descriptive_Label Human-readable UTF-8 bytes copied without
   --  transcoding; this constructor does not validate UTF-8.
   --  @return Ada-owned identifier independent of the supplied label storage.
   --  @exception Constraint_Error The label contains an embedded NUL.

   function UUID_Value (ID : UCI_ID) return UUID;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Descriptive_Label
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy an identifier's binary UUID independently of its descriptive label.
   --  @param ID Ada-owned identifier.
   --  @return All sixteen UUID bytes in their original order.

   function Descriptive_Label (ID : UCI_ID) return String;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Component_Location
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy the identifier's human-readable descriptive label.
   --  @param ID Ada-owned identifier.
   --  @return Independent Ada String of label bytes without transcoding.

   type Component_Location is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Create_Component_Location
Offset_X_M
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy component offsets and a logical mounting reference.
   --  @param Offset_X_M Forward offset from the host navigational center, meters.
   --  @param Offset_Y_M Rightward offset from the host navigational center, meters.
   --  @param Offset_Z_M Downward offset from the host navigational center, meters.
   --  @param Key Pylon, bay or other logical mounting-location identifier.
   --  @param System_Name External naming system for that key.
   --  @return Ada-owned location with copied text and unchanged offset scalars.
   --  @exception Constraint_Error Key or naming-system text contains embedded NUL.

   function Offset_X_M (Location : Component_Location) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Offset_Y_M
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Read the component's forward offset relative to the host navigational center.
   --  @param Location Component installation location.
   --  @return Stored forward displacement in meters, without conversion.

   function Offset_Y_M (Location : Component_Location) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Offset_Z_M
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Read the component's rightward offset relative to the host navigational center.
   --  @param Location Component installation location.
   --  @return Stored rightward displacement in meters, without conversion.

   function Offset_Z_M (Location : Component_Location) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Key
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Read the component's downward offset relative to the host navigational center.
   --  @param Location Component installation location.
   --  @return Stored downward displacement in meters, without conversion.

   function Key (Location : Component_Location) return String;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: System_Name
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy the logical mounting-location key, not the numeric offsets.
   --  @param Location Component installation location.
   --  @return Independent identifier text for the pylon, bay or logical location.

   function System_Name (Location : Component_Location) return String;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Image_Config
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy the naming system for the logical mounting-location key.
   --  @param Location Component installation location.
   --  @return Independent naming-system text, without resolving the key.

   type Image_Config is private;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Create_Image_Config
Image_Stream
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Assemble image configuration without loading or attaching a provider.
   --  Native capability, text and resource checks occur when the stream opens.
   --  @param Channel_ID Requested image-channel identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Platform_ID Host platform identity and descriptive label.
   --  @param Sensor_Location Sensor mounting offsets and external location key.
   --  @param Buffer_Count Positive number of host buffers to register.
   --  @param Buffer_Size Positive storage capacity in bytes for each buffer.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Positive bound on queued frames awaiting consumption.
   --  @return Ada-owned configuration preserving all supplied values.

   type Image_Stream is limited private;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Open_Image_Stream
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Limited controlled owner of a legacy native image stream. Default state
   --  is closed. Explicit Close reports errors; finalization provides non-raising
   --  cleanup fallback. Native ownership retains provider/session state as needed
   --  independently of the parent Ada Session object's lifetime.

   function Open_Image_Stream (Parent : Session; Config : Image_Config) return Image_Stream;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Attach an image channel using the advertised Mono8 single-band capability.
   --  Opening does not start image reception; call Start explicitly.
   --  @param Parent Open IR Session; serialize this call against parent closure.
   --  @param Config Channel/platform/location and bounded host-storage settings.
   --  @return Limited owner of an attached, not yet started, image stream.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Parent is closed or native validation, capability
   --  selection, acquisition or attachment fails, including invalid UTF-8 text.

   function Is_Open (Object : Image_Stream) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Start
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Inspect local stream-handle presence without calling the provider.
   --  @param Object Legacy image stream owner.
   --  @return True if a native handle is held, not a guarantee of enabled or
   --  healthy provider reception.

   procedure Start (Object : in out Image_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Image_Type
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Initialize/register host buffers and enable the attached image channel.
   --  @param Object Open stream to start; serialize lifecycle operations on it.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native registration, enable or state check fails.

   type Image_Type is (Staring, Scanning);

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Image_Flip
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Provider-reported acquisition kind, not a requested image transformation.
   --  @enum Staring Image acquired by a staring sensor.
   --  @enum Scanning Image acquired by a scanning sensor.

   type Image_Flip is (No_Flip, Vertical, Horizontal, Both);

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Frame
Receive
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Receive found no queued frame and the native stream is stopped.

   function Receive (Object : Image_Stream; Timeout_Milliseconds : Natural := 0) return Frame;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Counter
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Receive a copied legacy frame using native size-discovery then copy calls.
   --  At most one task may call Receive on this stream at a time. Queued frames
   --  precede stopped/failure reporting. Serialize closure against this call.
   --  @param Object Open legacy image stream whose next frame is consumed.
   --  @param Timeout_Milliseconds Wait duration in milliseconds; zero polls
   --  without waiting. A timeout neither stops the stream nor cancels provider work.
   --  @return Ada-owned pixels and selected scalar metadata for the next frame.
   --  @exception Timeout_Error No frame becomes available within the wait.
   --  @exception Stream_Stopped No queued frame remains and the stream is stopped.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Closed/failed stream, size discovery failure or
   --  a frame outside this wrapper's Mono8 single-band metadata profile.

   type Counter is mod 2**64 with Size => 64;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Stream_Counters
Counters
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Snapshot of callback/rejection diagnostics, not successful Ada reads.
   --  @field Frames_Received Incoming image callbacks counted before validation,
   --  including malformed data and queue-full drops.
   --  @field Frames_Dropped_Queue_Full Valid incoming frames rejected because
   --  the bounded receive queue has no space.
   --  @field Malformed_Or_Unsupported Malformed/unsupported callbacks and native
   --  callback failures rejected by the bridge, not timeout polls.

   function Counters (Object : Image_Stream) return Stream_Counters;

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Stop
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Copy current native stream counters without consuming a frame.
   --  @param Object Open legacy image stream.
   --  @return Independent diagnostic-count snapshot.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native query fails, including a closed owner.

   procedure Stop (Object : in out Image_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Close
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Stop acceptance and disable the stream with native cleanup/lifetime rules.
   --  Previously queued frames remain receivable before stopped reporting.
   --  This is not cancellation of every outstanding provider operation.
   --  @param Object Open stream to stop; serialize lifecycle operations.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native disable or cleanup/state check fails.

   procedure Close (Object : in out Image_Stream);

AMS.MEL.IR.name: Channel_View
AMS.MEL.IR.signature:
--  Release the public stream owner through native detach/cleanup. Repeated
   --  closure of a closed owner is harmless. Retained frames/requests or uncertain
   --  cleanup can retain the provider graph rather than unloading unsafe code.
   --  @param Object Stream to close; do not race closure with Receive or other
   --  operations on this Ada owner.
   --  @exception Provider_Error Native cleanup fails; explicit closure allows
   --  the caller to observe the failure instead of relying on finalization.

   --  Controlled owner of exactly one native weak common Channel view
   --  (ams_mel_ir_channel). Applications use it only through the subtype
   --  AMS.MEL.IR.Channel.View; its operations live in AMS.MEL.IR.Channel and
   --  the typed-family As_Channel conversions. It never owns the typed family
   --  state, Session, provider Channel, Control, or provider library.
   type Channel_View is limited private;

AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.name: Admin_MEL
AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.signature:
--  Independently owned RF administrative interface, separate from DataMEL
   --  and C2MEL. State commands use the provider's UCI status-control interface
   --  and the shared Common MEL state enumeration; no separate RF state model
   --  is introduced. Acceptance is not evidence of a physical state transition.
   --  Externally serialize operations on each owner, including closure and
   --  finalization. This package does not provide concurrent-handle protection.

   type Admin_MEL is limited private;

AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.name: Open
AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.signature:
--  Unique limited controlled owner of an AdminMEL and its provider-library
   --  reference. A default-initialized owner is closed. Explicit Close reports
   --  failures; finalization attempts closure without propagating exceptions.
   --  Native shutdown failure permanently retains the provider/library graph
   --  rather than destroying objects or unloading code at an uncertain boundary.
   function Open (Library_Path : String; Configuration : String) return Admin_MEL;

AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.name: Is_Open
AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.signature:
--  Load the provider library and invoke only its createAdminMEL factory with
   --  the configuration text. Does not open or borrow a DataMEL or C2MEL.
   --  Embedded NUL in either input raises a constraint error before allocation
   --  of temporary C strings or any provider call. Temporary strings are freed
   --  on both normal and exceptional exits. Native loading, symbol lookup,
   --  allocation, null-factory-result and factory-exception failures raise
   --  a provider error; no open owner is returned on those failures.
   --  @param Library_Path Provider shared-library path passed to the native loader.
   --  @param Configuration Provider-defined text passed synchronously as a string view; no bridge interpretation.
   --  @return Open unique administrative owner retaining the provider and library.
   function Is_Open (Object : Admin_MEL) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.name: Command_State
AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.signature:
--  Inspect only the local handle, without querying provider health or MFA
   --  state. False after Close even when shutdown failed and native resources
   --  remain permanently retained.
   --  @param Object Administrative owner whose local handle is inspected.
   --  @return True exactly when the owner holds a nonnull public native handle.
   function Command_State (Object : Admin_MEL; State : AMS.MEL.Status.MFA_State) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.name: Close
AMS.MEL.RF.Admin.signature:
--  Obtain fresh shared UCI and status-control owners and call upstream
   --  StatusControl::commandState. All fifteen Common MEL representations
   --  0 through 14 are accepted by bridge validation, including the unset,
   --  Unknown and Degraded; provider support and acceptance remain separate.
   --  There is no bridge transition table, status polling or completion wait.
   --  Closed owners, null required provider interfaces, provider exceptions or
   --  malformed native Boolean results raise a provider error, not False.
   --  @param Object Open administrative owner; externally serialize its use.
   --  @param State Shared MFA state command, mapped by its checked enumeration representation.
   --  @return Provider acceptance Boolean; False is normal rejection and True does not prove hardware transition.
   procedure Close (Object : in out Admin_MEL);

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Connection_Snapshot
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Conditional VA-level connection snapshots and endpoint associations, separate from
   --  descriptor-level optional pipes. Values own their data and retain no provider lifetime.
   --  Each mutation obtains a fresh VA connection map and invokes the exact provider operation
   --  once, with no automatic capability gate, retry or readback. Externally serialize same-VA
   --  operations and Close; the existing VA owner remains valid after public C2 Close.

   type Connection_Snapshot is private;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Element_Group_Connection
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Ada-owned VA-level connection copy, distinct from optional ElementGroup descriptor
   --  pipes. Outer group keys ascend unsigned UTF-8 bytes without normalization or locale
   --  collation. Copies survive VA/C2 closure and provider unload.

   type Element_Group_Connection is private;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Data_Pipe_Connection
Endpoint_ID_Array
Snapshot
Group_Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Make a fresh conditional VA getDataPipes call and copy labels and endpoint sets through
   --  temporary native snapshot ownership. Required upstream only with endpoint association.
   --  Invalid UTF-8, null pipes and native/provider failures raise Provider Error. No
   --  capability auto-gate or atomic multi-getter guarantee.
   --  @param Object Live VA; externally serialize all same-VA operations, including Close. The
   --  existing VA claim survives public C2 closure.
   --  @return Independent VA connections, including successful empty collections.

   function Group_Count (Value : Connection_Snapshot) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Group_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Count stored outer group map entries.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied group count, including zero.

   function Group_At
     (Value : Connection_Snapshot; Index : Positive) return Element_Group_Connection;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Element_Group_Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Copy a group in ascending unsigned UTF-8 outer-key byte order.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint
   --  Error.
   --  @return Independent group and its copied nested pipes.

   --  Outer lookup keys ascend unsigned UTF-8 bytes, no normalization/locale.
   function Element_Group_Label (Value : Element_Group_Connection) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Pipe_Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Read the original outer group lookup key, not a descriptor display-label query.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 group lookup-key bytes, not normalized.

   function Pipe_Count (Value : Element_Group_Connection) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Pipe_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Count stored inner pipe map entries, preserving aliases as separate entries.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied pipe count, including zero.

   --  Inner pipes preserve provider std::map traversal, including aliases.
   function Pipe_At
     (Value : Element_Group_Connection; Index : Positive) return Data_Pipe_Connection;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Lookup_Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Copy a pipe in provider std::map traversal order; no locale-dependent resorting.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint
   --  Error.
   --  @return Independent pipe with its lookup key, display label and endpoint IDs.

   function Lookup_Label (Value : Data_Pipe_Connection) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Read the original inner pipe lookup key, distinct from returned label and object
   --  identity.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 pipe map key.

   --  Returned label is NOT the lookup key or provider object identity.
   function Label (Value : Data_Pipe_Connection) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Endpoint_Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Read the provider-returned pipe display label, not its map key.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 label, which may differ from the lookup key.

   function Endpoint_Count (Value : Data_Pipe_Connection) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Endpoint_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Count copied provider endpoint set entries; this is not a connectivity test.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Set cardinality with duplicates collapsed, including zero.

   function Endpoint_At
     (Value : Data_Pipe_Connection; Index : Positive) return Interfaces.Unsigned_64;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Associate_Endpoint
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Read the provider std::set endpoint order, not insertion order.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint
   --  Error.
   --  @return Unsigned 64-bit endpoint ID preserving all bits.

   --  Each command obtains its own fresh VA::getDataPipes value and invokes
   --  the exact mutation once. True/False is successful provider return data,
   --  not proof of routing, connectivity, RDMA/Q-pairs, hardware or persistence.
   --  No cache/capability gate/retry/readback. Missing keys raise Provider_Error.
   --  Embedded NUL raises Constraint_Error before native entry; C validates UTF-8.
   function Associate_Endpoint
     (Object                               : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class;
      Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String;
      Endpoint_ID                          : Interfaces.Unsigned_64) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.name: Associate_Endpoints
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Data_Pipes.signature:
--  Obtain a fresh VA getDataPipes map, resolve existing exact keys, then invoke
   --  associateEndpoint exactly once. Missing keys are errors, never automatic insertions. No
   --  capability gate, retry, cache or state readback. Native/provider failures raise Provider
   --  Error. Provider acceptance does not establish actual connectivity, RDMA/Q-pairs,
   --  writable memory registration, hardware routing, persistent configuration or physical
   --  data delivery.
   --  @param Object Live VA; externally serialize all same-VA operations, including Close. The
   --  existing VA claim survives public C2 closure.
   --  @param Element_Group_Label Exact outer lookup key; embedded NUL raises Constraint Error
   --  before native entry. Native code validates UTF-8.
   --  @param Data_Pipe_Label Exact inner lookup key, not returned display label. Embedded NUL
   --  raises Constraint Error; native code validates UTF-8.
   --  @param Endpoint_ID Exact unsigned 64-bit endpoint ID, without narrowing or local
   --  membership checks.
   --  @return True or False is successful provider return data, not transport status or a
   --  connectivity guarantee.

   --  Upstream std::set semantics: ordering insignificant, duplicates collapse.
   --  An empty array is valid and forwarded as an empty set exactly once.
   function Associate_Endpoints
     (Object                               : in out Virtual_Aperture'Class;
      Element_Group_Label, Data_Pipe_Label : String;
      Endpoint_IDs                         : Endpoint_ID_Array) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Element_Group_Mode
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Snapshots of required ElementGroup descriptors with optional conditional nested DataPipe
   --  acquisition. One explicit snapshot uses multiple provider getters, not an atomic
   --  transaction. Lookup keys and display labels remain distinct. Copied getters never access
   --  the provider; live acquisition requires external serialization with all same-VA
   --  operations, including Close.

   type Element_Group_Mode is (Receive, Transmit);

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Element_Group_List
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature: type Element_Group_List is private;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Element_Group_Descriptor
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Ada-owned descriptor collection sorted by unsigned UTF-8 lookup-key bytes. No text
   --  normalization or locale collation; no native handle, Close or provider-aware finalizer.
   --  Copies survive VA/C2/provider closure.

   type Element_Group_Descriptor is private;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Data_Pipe_Info
Snapshot_Element_Groups
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Copied optional descriptor-level pipe lookup key, returned label and endpoint set.
   --  Distinct from the VA-level connections exposed by Data Pipes.

   function Snapshot_Element_Groups
     (Object : Virtual_Aperture'Class; Include_Data_Pipes : Boolean := False)
      return Element_Group_List;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Obtain required getElementGroups and multiple descriptor getters, optionally acquiring
   --  conditional descriptor DataPipes and their labels/endpoints. This is not an atomic
   --  multi-getter transaction. Native snapshot storage is copied to Ada then released.
   --  Invalid UTF-8, null provider objects, unknown modes and native/provider failures raise
   --  Provider Error; no partial snapshot is returned.
   --  @param Object Live VA; externally serialize all same-VA operations, including Close. The
   --  existing VA claim survives public C2 closure.
   --  @param Include_Data_Pipes If True, query nested descriptor pipes. False means not
   --  queried, not absent or unsupported; an included empty map is different.
   --  @return Independent sorted descriptors; successful empty collections are retained.

   function Count (Value : Element_Group_List) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Descriptor_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Count copied descriptors without querying the provider.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Stored descriptor count, possibly zero.

   function Descriptor_At
     (Value : Element_Group_List; Index : Positive) return Element_Group_Descriptor;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Data_Pipes_Included
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Copy a descriptor in deterministic unsigned UTF-8 lookup-key byte order.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint
   --  Error.
   --  @return Independent descriptor, not a live provider object.

   function Data_Pipes_Included (Value : Element_Group_List) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Data_Pipes_Included
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Inspect stored nested-pipe acquisition state, not provider capability. False means no
   --  nested query was made; True with zero pipes means a queried empty result.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Whether descriptor-level DataPipes were included at acquisition.

   function Data_Pipes_Included (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Lookup_Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Inspect stored nested-pipe acquisition state, not provider capability. False means no
   --  nested query was made; True with zero pipes means a queried empty result.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Whether descriptor-level DataPipes were included at acquisition.

   --  Lookup keys and returned labels are distinct, not provider identities.
   --  Descriptors ascend unsigned UTF-8 lookup-key bytes without normalization.
   function Lookup_Label (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read the original provider map lookup key, distinct from the returned display label and
   --  not a provider-object identity.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 lookup-key bytes without normalization.

   function Label (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Mode
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read the provider-returned display label, which may differ from the map lookup key. No
   --  identity equivalence is inferred.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 provider label without normalization.

   function Mode (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Element_Group_Mode;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Max_RF_Bandwidth_Hz
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read the copied provider RX/TX direction without live access.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Receive or Transmit group mode; not physical activity confirmation.

   function Max_RF_Bandwidth_Hz (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Max_Sample_Rate_Samples_Per_Second
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read copied provider maximum RF bandwidth. No clipping, range enforcement or physical-
   --  validity inference; signed zero, negative values, infinity and NaN classification
   --  survive numeric conversion, without a NaN payload-bit guarantee.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Provider maximum RF bandwidth in Hz.

   function Max_Sample_Rate_Samples_Per_Second (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Max_Data_Rate_Bits_Per_Second
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read copied provider maximum sample rate. No clipping, range enforcement or physical-
   --  validity inference; signed zero, negative values, infinity and NaN classification
   --  survive numeric conversion, without a NaN payload-bit guarantee.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Provider maximum sample rate in samples per second.

   function Max_Data_Rate_Bits_Per_Second (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Max_Duty_Factor
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read copied provider maximum data rate. No clipping, range enforcement or physical-
   --  validity inference; signed zero, negative values, infinity and NaN classification
   --  survive numeric conversion, without a NaN payload-bit guarantee.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Provider maximum data rate in bits per second.

   --  Dimensionless; upstream states 0 < value <= 1. Values are not repaired.
   --  All numerics forward negative values, signed zero, infinity and NaN.
   --  NaN payload-bit preservation and physical validity are not promised.
   function Max_Duty_Factor (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Long_Float;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Pipe_Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read copied provider maximum duty factor. No clipping, range enforcement or physical-
   --  validity inference; signed zero, negative values, infinity and NaN classification
   --  survive numeric conversion, without a NaN payload-bit guarantee. Upstream describes 0 <
   --  value <= 1, with 1 denoting CW; the bridge does not enforce or repair that interval.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Provider maximum duty factor in dimensionless ratio.

   --  Count is stored entries. CHECK Data_Pipes_Included before interpreting
   --  zero as an observed absence. False means not queried, not unsupported.
   function Pipe_Count (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Pipe_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Count stored descriptor pipes. Check Data Pipes Included first: zero with False means
   --  not queried, unlike a successful included empty result.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Stored nested pipe count, possibly zero.

   function Pipe_At (Value : Element_Group_Descriptor; Index : Positive) return Data_Pipe_Info;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Lookup_Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Copy a nested descriptor pipe in provider std::map traversal order.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @param Index Positive one-based position; beyond the stored count raises Constraint
   --  Error.
   --  @return Independent nested pipe information, with lookup key distinct from display
   --  label.

   function Lookup_Label (Value : Data_Pipe_Info) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Label
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read the original provider map lookup key, distinct from the returned display label and
   --  not a provider-object identity.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 lookup-key bytes without normalization.

   function Label (Value : Data_Pipe_Info) return String;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Endpoint_Count
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Read the provider-returned display label, which may differ from the map lookup key. No
   --  identity equivalence is inferred.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Copied UTF-8 provider label without normalization.

   function Endpoint_Count (Value : Data_Pipe_Info) return Natural;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.name: Endpoint_At
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Element_Groups.signature:
--  Count copied associated endpoint set entries, without querying connectivity.
   --  @param Value Independent Ada-owned copied value; no live provider access or retained
   --  native owner.
   --  @return Stored endpoint count, including zero.

   function Endpoint_At (Value : Data_Pipe_Info; Index : Positive) return Interfaces.Unsigned_64;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.name: Stream
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.signature:
--  Observe provider JobIntervalStatus callbacks without owning a JobDetail
   --  or any provider-resource graph. The callback receives status by value;
   --  its exact callable holder, bridge state and DSO pin remain for process
   --  lifetime because upstream provides no unregister or quiescence contract.
   --  Registration success is not evidence of callback delivery or scheduling.
   --  Serialize operations on an owner with that owner's destruction.

   --  Observer only. No provider-resource ownership or callback into Ada.
   type Stream is tagged limited private;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.name: Open
Is_Open
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.signature:
--  Attempt registration once on the Job, before Finalize or full Cancel.
   --  A synchronous callback during registration is supported. An exposed
   --  registration attempt is consumed even if the provider throws.
   --  The fixed FIFO drops incoming observations when full; malformed enums,
   --  oversize payloads and allocation failures discard whole observations.
   --  Limits bound queued storage, not provider argument construction,
   --  concurrent callback temporaries or application-held Status Event copies.
   --  Native option/lifecycle/registration failures raise Provider Error.
   --  @param Object Live Job whose status is observed, not retained by Stream.
   --  @param Queue_Capacity Maximum number of queued observations; positive.
   --  @param Max_Event_Log_Entries Maximum entries per observation; zero allows
   --    only an empty log.
   --  @param Max_Activity_ID_Bytes Maximum activity bytes per observation; zero
   --    allows only an empty activity ID.
   --  @return Open observer; no delivery or physical RF activity is promised.
   function Is_Open (Object : Stream) return Boolean;

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.name: Close
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.signature:
--  Test local handle ownership, not provider liveness or pending callbacks.
   --  @param Object Observer to inspect.
   --  @return True while the local native handle exists, even if stopped.
   procedure Close (Object : in out Stream);

AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.name: Completion_Status
AMS.MEL.RF.C2.Interval_Status.signature:
--  Receive observed stopped reception, distinct from Timeout Error and from
   --  a provider-reported failure contained in a Completion Status value.
   type Completion_Status is
     (None,
      Ready_For_Next_Job_Interval,
      Failed_Interrupted,
      Failed_Invalid_Tx_Event_Spatial_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Tx_Event_Signal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Tx_Event_Temporal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Tx_Event_Identifier_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Rx_Event_Spatial_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Rx_Event_Signal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Rx_Event_Temporal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Rx_Event_Identifier_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Sequence_Temporal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Interval_Spatial_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Interval_Event_Signal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Interval_Event_Temporal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Interval_Event_Identifier_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Temporal_Data,
      Failed_Invalid_Job_Identifier_Data,
      Completed,
      Cancelled,
      Late_Controls,
      Invalid_Controls,
      Antenna_Fov_Error,
      Transmit_Rf_Inhibited,
      Started);
